- Team, Professional, Business, Enterprise and Software UI/UX plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

The submitter portal provides a secure and easy way to embed *Submit files* functionality into a website or local intranet.

#### Submitter Portal Functionality

The portal provides these functions:

- Selection of source and target languages.
- [Service](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709616197788#UUID-f021f3f3-3659-b700-c1a6-421cf8ce5b5b "Services (TMS)") selection.
- Upload or drag and drop files for translation or remove if required.
- If set in the portal, files can be uploaded from online repositories,

  Only available in the client portal.
- Set an email address.

  Requires only initial verification.
- Set time and due date.
- Enter Purchase Order Number.
- Add a note.
- Check word count and pricing.
- Upload of reference files.

#### Submitter Portal Use Cases

- Translation agencies provide multiple submitter portals to their customers.

  - Facilitate easier submission of jobs from both internal and external clients.
  - Distributed to different internal business units to streamline internal translation processes.
- Associate with Services and Project Templates

  - Pre-specify project settings; [price lists](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709625473436#UUID-95ab5b98-50d1-a2e5-ca91-e80e85131cbc), [translation memories](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75), [term bases](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503), etc.
- Create specific portals.

  - One portal specified for internal use, others with different specifications for external customers.

#### Set up Submitter Portal

**Pre-requisites**: At least one existing [Service](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709616197788#UUID-f021f3f3-3659-b700-c1a6-421cf8ce5b5b "Services (TMS)").

If providers are to be used, ensure the [project template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-0d4861e8-5219-9b5f-3a49-4fe65f7bd211 "Project Templates (TMS)") for the service includes them.

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682273206044)page, scroll down to the Automation section and click on Submitter portals. The Submitter portals page opens.
2. Click New.

   The Create Submitter portal page opens.
3. Complete required fields:

   - Name

     Provide a name for the portal. This name will not be displayed in the portal itself.
   - Disable public portal URL
   - If the user is logged in to the correct organization, URL access is granted.
   - If the user is logged in with the wrong profile or is not logged in, URL access is denied.
   - Authorize user to access portal URL

     Lock access to the portal URL to only users within the organization with a profile.

     - If the user is logged in to the correct organization, URL access is granted.
     - If the user is logged in with the wrong profile, URL access is denied.
     - If the user is not logged in, they are redirected to login page.

     If both Disable public portal URL and Authorize user to access portal URL are selected, the users will experience the behavior tied to Authorize user to access portal URL.

     Leave both Disable public portal URL and Authorize user to access portal URL unchecked to allow submitters to access the portal without logging in to Phrase. In this configuration, submitters verify their email address before submitting files, and no Phrase account is required.
   - Service

     Select the services that this portal will perform.
   - Automatically select all languages

     Select whether users should select languages manually or if languages should be selected automatically.
   - Default project title

     [Template macros](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709617392540#UUID-ab9ad063-eb5e-9a11-a4b4-78c673051419 "Email Templates and Submitter Portal Macros (TMS)"), such as {order.number}, {order.email} and {order.date} can be used to create project names.
   - Allow users to specify project name

     Choose whether users should be able to set a project title themselves from the portal page, or if a default name should be applied.
   - Assign portal to new submitters

     When creating a Submitter user, they will require at least one Submitter portal. Assigning in advance can save time.
   - Connectors

     Select [connectors](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709656492572#UUID-2aebdc84-c474-f68d-92e3-a50eb8966572) that submitters can use.

     submitters must sign in to the client portal to use connectors; they are not available to anonymous submitters.
   - Default project owner
   - Portal UI language
   - Welcome message

     This message will be shown to users accessing the site. The following HTML elements and attributes are supported:

     - **<b>**, **<strong>**, **<u>**, **<i>**, **<em>**, **<p>**, **<br>** (supported attributes: **title**, **style**, **class**)
     - **<img>** (supported attributes: **title**, **style**, **class**, **src**, **alt**, **width**, **height**)
     - **<a>** (supported attributes: **title**, **style**, **class**, **href**, **target**)
4. Email templates

   Select any required [email templates](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709617392540#UUID-ab9ad063-eb5e-9a11-a4b4-78c673051419 "Email Templates and Submitter Portal Macros (TMS)").
5. IFrame & appearance

   Modify the IFrame HTML Code and customize the portal itself.

   - IFrame HTML Code

     This is available only after a portal has been created and is used to embed the portal into a website.
   - Customize *Background Color*, *Content Color*, and *Box Color* using CSS color codes or CSS color names.
6. Click Save.

   The portal is added to the list.
7. Click on the portal name to view the URL for distribution.

   The URL or the entire portal can be embedded into a website.

#### Analysis and Quotes for Buyers and Providers

When creating a project using the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709617392540#UUID-ab9ad063-eb5e-9a11-a4b4-78c673051419 "Email Templates and Submitter Portal Macros (TMS)"), analyses and quotes can be created for buyers or be disabled. Options are in the Financials section of the service settings.

To create analyses and quotes for providers as well, select the Create for provider as well option for the related [service](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709616197788#UUID-f021f3f3-3659-b700-c1a6-421cf8ce5b5b "Services (TMS)").

Buyer analysis and quotes specifics:

- Analysis for buyer is always created *by language*. This overrules settings for the default analysis as set in a project template.
- *Default* analysis is always used. This overrules settings for the default analysis as set in a project template.

Provider analysis and quotes specifics:

- Only created for the first [workflow step](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-3d4fec12-4a9f-ace5-cd20-a1575786a6b7).
- Only created when linguist/vendor is assigned in the [project template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-0d4861e8-5219-9b5f-3a49-4fe65f7bd211 "Project Templates (TMS)").
- The provider always creates the analysis and it is assigned to the corresponding linguist or vendor.
- Linguist [net rate scheme](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709665578908#UUID-271da169-10bc-f829-9b5d-421d21407b8f) is applied first. If not defined, the net rate scheme from the project template is applied.
- Linguist [price list](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709625473436#UUID-95ab5b98-50d1-a2e5-ca91-e80e85131cbc) is applied first. If not defined, the price list from the project template is applied. A quote cannot be created if no price list is provided.

#### File Handover in Submitter Portal Projects

If [file handover](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-3d4fec12-4a9f-ace5-cd20-a1575786a6b7) is used in projects created through submitter portal, the final files can be downloaded from the portal page using the Download all button.

If File handover is not used, the Download all button downloads completed files.

File handover is not available for jobs created from a connector. For connector-based Submitter Portal projects, delivery back to the connected repository can run automatically when combined with [project status automation rules](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091328028#UUID-1b4ea28a-d66f-0cf7-6a75-f04f8dc61a3e), or manually via Download/Export to Online Repository from the project page.

#### Embedding the Portal

There are three methods to embed the portal into a website or an intranet page. The first two do not require expert knowledge, while the last one should be handled by a webmaster.

A portal can only be embedded in an IFrame when the options Disable public widget URL and Authorize user to access widget URL are disabled.

**Portal URL**

Follow these steps:

1. Click on the portal name in the list of portals to view the URL for distribution.
2. Use the URL on a website or intranet page.

**Portal IFrame**

The entire portal form can be embedded into your website or intranet page. This provides a seamless experience if the portal is presented as an integral part of website.

Follow these steps:

1. Click on the portal name in the list of portals.
2. Expand the IFrame & Appearance window.
3. Copy the IFrame HTML Code.
4. Paste the copied code into the website.

   Customize *Background Color*, *Content Color*, and *Box Color* using CSS color codes or CSS color names.

**Portal IFrame with resizing**

Without resizing support, the portal layout may be slightly altered, or a scroll bar may appear within the portal. This does not affect the functionality, but it may not look as nice.

A more advanced method of using the IFrame with Javascript provides automatic resizing of the portal when the Note or Paste Text fields are expanded.

The Automation form uses the IFrame-resizer Javascript library to provide the desired functionality and a clean and simple API.

To enable portal IFrame with resizing, have the webmaster follow these steps:

1. Create access to the Jquery library. As an example, include the following HTML code in the <head>;</head> part of the web page:

   `<script src="http://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/1.11.0/jquery.min.js"></script>`
2. Create access to the IFrame-resizer library.

   As an example, include the following HTML code in the head section:

   `<script type="text/javascript" src="<path-to-iframeResizer-parent-folder>/iframeResizer.min.js"></script>`
3. Provide an ID to the IFrame element and disable scrollbars.

   As an example:

   `<iframe id="phrase-iq" scrolling="no" ... ></iframe>`
4. In the head section of the HTML, add the following HTML/Javascript code:

   `<script type="text/javascript"> $(document).ready( function () { $('#phrase-iq').iFrameResize({ heightCalculationMethod: 'documentElementScroll' }); }) </script>`

This is a simple HTML page that implements all the steps above. It assumes the iframeResizer.min.js file is located in the same folder as the example HTML page:

```
  <!DOCTYPE html> 
  <html> 
  <head> 
  <script src="http://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/1.11.0/jquery.min.js"></script>
  <script type="text/javascript" src="./iframeResizer.min.js"></script>
  <script type="text/javascript"> $(document).ready( function () { $('#phrase-iq').iFrameResize({
  heightCalculationMethod: 'documentElementScroll' }); }) </script> 
  </head>
  <body> 
  <div style="width: 530px; margin: 0 auto;" >
  <iframe id="phrase-iq"   scrolling="no" width="530px" height="400px" frameborder="0"
  src="https://cloud.memsource.com/web/submitJob/1-soXGd-xgCbx?embedded=true"/>
  </iframe> 
  </div> 
  </body> 
  </html>
```

### Services (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709616197788-Services-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-07-21T10:13:47Z  
> Labels: Automation, 2BTr, ar_tms

Services are used in [submitter portals](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-895c1049-1178-6c17-109b-55bc8b33a361 "Submitter Portal (TMS)") and in [automated project creation (legacy)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-2558de58-eb7e-d298-f22a-d41dd17b1de6 "Automated Project Creation - APC (TMS)"). They define a service product made available to a submitter with set parameters such as languages available, billing units, rates, etc.. They function as templates applied to automatically created projects.

#### Set up Services

To set up services, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682303786652) page, scroll down to the Automation section.
2. Click Services.

   The Services page opens.
3. Click New.

   The Create page opens.
4. Complete required fields:

   - **A public and private name**

     The public name is displayed in the portal with the private being the internal name.
   - **Service type**

     Professional Translation is the only option.
   - **Source and Target languages**
   - **[Project templates](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-0d4861e8-5219-9b5f-3a49-4fe65f7bd211 "Project Templates (TMS)")**

     Select appropriate Project Templates to be used when this Service is selected. Only add templates with languages fitting the Service languages.

     If multiple templates are selected, the system will select the one that best fits the selection from the Service; an EN->DE template will not be used for EN->FR translations.

     Workflow steps in the template must also be set in the service.
   - **[Buyers](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703948444#UUID-2fb330ab-e5ad-e017-5972-a9a75c1e0360)**
   - **[Workflow steps](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-3d4fec12-4a9f-ace5-cd20-a1575786a6b7)** Not available in all editions.

     Projects created via this Service will include the specified workflow steps.

     The workflow steps in the Service must contain same or more steps as the Project Template.
   - **Job due date**
   - **[Due date scheme](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647457308#UUID-0e2570ac-5170-51a4-945c-c5352ba81621 "Due Date Schemes (TMS)")**

     Due date will be automatically calculated (The Date Picker will be disabled in public submitter portal page.)
   - **Financials**

     [Analysis](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-7ed2ed16-6064-f667-bb86-7d971d7004c9) and [quote](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709635877020#UUID-317de099-f8f9-9c94-dde1-36018cb96947) creation options.

     Select Create for provider as well if allowing providers access to financials.
   - **[Net rate scheme](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709665578908#UUID-271da169-10bc-f829-9b5d-421d21407b8f)**
   - **Billing unit**
   - **[Price list](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709625473436#UUID-95ab5b98-50d1-a2e5-ca91-e80e85131cbc)**
5. Click Save.

   The new Service is added to list.

### Project Templates (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772-Project-Templates-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-08-25T06:12:19Z  
> Labels: Automation, 2BTr, ar_tms

A project template is used in [project creation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709748435484#UUID-fd006a60-d1b0-dc4b-8681-00d5464cd76e). Repeating project criteria is maintained for regular clients, projects shared with Vendors, or projects created with the submitter portal. Use of a template streamlines the submission process and reduces errors.

#### Create a Project Template

Project templates are created in two ways:

- directly.
- from existing projects.

When created from an existing project, the project settings are automatically propagated to the template and can be adjusted before saving.

To create a new project template directly, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682255144476) page, scroll down to the Automation section and click on Project Templates.

   The Project Templates page opens.
2. Click on ![Add New](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682322076316) New.

   The Create Project Template page opens.
3. Provide a name and configure project details, project settings, resources and file import settings as required.
4. Click Create.

   Template is added to the list of Project templates.

To save an existing project as a template, follow these steps:

1. Open an existing project.
2. Click Save as and select Save as a template.

   The Create project template page opens.
3. Provide a name and configure project details, project settings, resources and file import settings as required.
4. Click Create.

   Template is added to the list of Project templates.

##### Note

Linguists are not saved from the project. They can be added manually by editing the template.

#### Manage Project Templates

To edit a project template, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682255144476) page, scroll down to the Automation section and click on Project Templates.

   The Project Templates page opens.
2. Click on a template.

   The Edit Project Template page opens.
3. Change project settings and click Save.

   The changes are applied to the selected template.

   ### Note

   Changing the settings in a project template does not affect the settings of existing projects created on the basis of that template.

The list tools in the upper right corner of the list are used to sort, filter and customize the list of Project Templates. Users can reorder columns as needed. Column order is saved per browser.

Project templates do not keep a change history. A template stores only its current configuration and earlier versions of a template are not retained and cannot be restored or compared.

##### Tip

Project templates can be duplicated via [API](https://developers.phrase.com/en/home), creating a new template as a copy of the source, which can then be renamed and adjusted independently. The UI does not offer an option to clone a template directly. To duplicate a project template through the UI, save an existing project as a new template instead.

#### Batch-Manage Translation Memories

Project templates support batch management of translation memories (TMs) across multiple languages and workflow steps, using the Add batch TMs action. This enables removing, reordering or resetting TMs across multiple languages and workflow steps in a single batch action.

To batch-manage translation memories, follow these steps:

1. From the Edit Project Template page, navigate to Resources/Translation memories.
2. Click Add batch TMs.

   The Add batch translation memories (TM) window opens. The window pre-loads translation memories already in use for the selected scope, even when order, write mode, or penalty settings differ across languages or workflow steps.
3. Under Add method,

   - select Add TMs to keep existing TMs for the selected scope and add new ones on top. Matching TMs may be replaced.
   - select Replace TMs to remove existing TMs from the selected scope and apply the new list instead.
4. Under Languages, select All or Specific to scope the affected languages. If Specific is selected, select affected target languages from the dropdown.
5. Under Workflow steps, select All or Specific to scope the affected workflow steps. If Specific is selected, select affected workflow steps from the dropdown.
6. Under Selected translation memories, add up to 20 TMs, with a maximum of 2 in write mode.

   - Turn on [Set priority order](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709739807260#UUID-474bfced-f444-b60b-864f-6b3763e23425) to control the sequence in which TMs are applied.
   - Set penalty and write mode for each TM.
   - Click the `X` next to a TM to remove it from the batch.
7. Click `Confirm` to apply the changes.

#### Using Project Templates

To create a new project using a template, follow these steps:

1. From the Projects page, click New project.

   The Create Project page opens.
2. From the Use Template field, select a template from the dropdown list.

   The project is populated with options specified in the template.
3. Change options if required.
4. Click Create.

   A new project is created with specified options.

Click through [tutorial](http://phrase.navattic.com/wu1h04wr) on template creation and use.

#### Assign Providers from a Template

Project Managers can assign providers (Linguists or Vendors) to each of the project workflow steps using an existing Project Template.

The number of workflow steps and the source language in the chosen project template must match those in the new project or the project template will not appear in the list. Target languages can be different, but at least one of the target languages must be the same.

Assigning providers from a template will not overwrite any existing assignments. Providers can be assigned from multiple templates as long as the templates match the criteria.

When a project is created from a template that includes providers, those providers are automatically added to any job created in the project.

##### Note

API behavior is slightly different. When a project is created from a template that includes providers, those providers are not automatically added when a job is created in the new project. To include them, use the `Assign providers from template` call.

To assign a provider from a template, follow these steps:

1. From the [job table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420#UUID-33f88350-daa8-2ab2-e7ce-e35300ec60f8), select specific jobs to assign providers.

   ### Note

   Providers can be assigned to a maximum of 100 jobs at once.

   Repeat this step to batch assign providers to more than 100 jobs.
2. Click Tools and select Assign providers from a Template.

   The Assign providers from a Template window opens.
3. Select a project template from the dropdown menu and optionally to Apply providers to just the selected jobs.

   A list of defined workflow steps and potential providers is displayed. Clicking on the workflow step presents provider details.
4. Click Assign.

   Providers from selected template are assigned to the selected job(s).

Click through [tutorial](http://phrase.navattic.com/gl180hnx) on assigning providers from a template.

### Due Date Schemes (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647457308-Due-Date-Schemes-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-07-21T10:13:49Z  
> Labels: Automation, 2BTr, ar_tms

Due date schemes allow users to configure a set of conditions which will be used to automatically calculate a due date for projects received via the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-895c1049-1178-6c17-109b-55bc8b33a361 "Submitter Portal (TMS)") or [automated project creation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-2558de58-eb7e-d298-f22a-d41dd17b1de6 "Automated Project Creation - APC (TMS)").

#### Due date calculation

- The due date is calculated for each language based on the total net words for that language (as seen in the summary table in the respective analysis), the latest date is then used for the project due date.
- The due date is calculated based on the operating system time zone settings.
- Net counts (e.g. net word count) are used if the net rate scheme is specified in the [service](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709616197788#UUID-f021f3f3-3659-b700-c1a6-421cf8ce5b5b "Services (TMS)").
- When SP and APC generate analysis for the first workflow step:

  - The net rate scheme for the first workflow step is used.
  - The number of workflow steps has no impact on the calculation.

#### Set up Due Date Scheme

Follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682255228188) page, scroll down to the Automation section and click on Due date schemes.

   The Due date schemes page opens.
2. Click New.

   The Create page opens.
3. Specify scheme details.

   Name, Quota and Office hours are mandatory fields.

   - Quota

     Quota is used to determine the volume of characters, words or pages that can be processed within a given time period. The combination of these two factors is used to calculate an hourly rate for which documents can be translated.

     When a document is submitted, the values are used to calculate the approximate delivery time (e.g. it takes 5 hours to translate 50 words).

     The lowest calculation threshold is set to 2 hours. This ensures that even small assignments do not add up to create unrealistic delivery times.
   - Working days

     Working days specify what days assignments are worked on and used to calculate a Due Date.

     Non-business days can be used to exclude specific days from the calculation (e.g. bank holidays, or a company-wide absence).
   - Office hours

     Office hours specify which hours of the given workday work is performed on assignments.

     Depending on when the Due Date falls, they are also used to specify the Start of the calculation and Delivery times.
   - Start

     Specifies the starting time of the calculation depending on whether the documents have been received during or after office hours. The calculation can start immediately, a specific number of hours after submission, or at a specific day and time.

     **Use case:**

     - The calculation for jobs received DURING office hours starts immediately after document is received.
     - The calculation for jobs received AFTER office hours starts at the beginning of the next working day.

     Small jobs (e.g. 10 words) submitted less than 2 hours before the end of office hours are regarded as being delivered AFTER office hours. This ensures that small assignments are not delivered late due to being submitted near the end of the office hours and not being addressed in time.
   - Delivery

     Based on the Quota, Office hours, and Start time, a Due Date is automatically calculated using an hourly rate. Depending on the size, this determines when jobs should be delivered but may fall both during and after specified office hours or working days. Delivery rules specify how the deadline should be adjusted if the Due Date falls outside of the desired time ranges. Due Date can also be adjusted for jobs to be delivered within office hours.

     **Use case:**

     - A job’s due date falls on Wednesday, 18:00 (outside of office hours),

       - Rule defines that job is not delivered immediately, but in the next working day at a specified hour.
     - A job is calculated to be delivered at 13:00 (inside office hours).

       - Rule defines that job is delivered immediately or at a specified hour during the same working day.
   - Large assignments

     The automatically calculated due date can be extended by a specified number of hours or days depending on the size of the received job.

     Click ![Add Size Exception](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682289721244) to add more size exceptions.

### Common Translation Interface (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709610752796-Common-Translation-Interface-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-18T14:33:33Z  
> Labels: Automation, 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Business and Enterprise plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Ultimate and Enterprise plans (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

COTI is an interface developed by DERCOM (Association of German Manufacturers of Authoring and Content Management Systems) for data exchange between authoring systems and translation systems.

Level 2 COTI integration is supported.

A COTI package must exist in the content management system (CMS) in order for Phrase to use it. See [DERCOM documentation](https://www.dercom.de/en/projekte) for more information.

#### Set up CMS Monitoring

The exchange folder for the exported COTI files needs to be linked to a [supported connector](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709656492572#UUID-2aebdc84-c474-f68d-92e3-a50eb8966572) to use the COTI project creation feature.

To set up a folder, follow these steps:

1. Configure the required online repository connector.
2. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682336492700) page, scroll down to the Automation section.
3. Click on COTI project creation.

   The COTI project creation page opens.
4. Click New.

   The Create page opens.
5. Provide a name for the project.
6. Click Select remote folder.

   Select the required folder from the required repository.
7. Click OK.

   The specified folder is checked for required COTI subfolders. If none are found, a warning is displayed.
8. Set Frequency.
9. Provide additional setting and specify Email templates.
10. Click Save.

    The project is added to the list.

**Downloading COTI Archives and Project Creation**

When a new COTI file is detected in the exchange folder, Phrase automatically downloads and analyzes it. If recognized as a valid COTI archive, a new project will be created.

Check in an editor to ensure that the COTI file is imported correctly.

If there is an issue in the CAT web editor, create a Project Template and adjust the import settings to address the issue. Project properties (source and target languages, for example) are defined by the COTI file. The file contains metadata that is extracted and used to set up the project.

The number of jobs in a project depend on the number of translatable files in a COTI archive. It may also contain reference files that are attached to the project which are not translated.

**Translating COTI Files**

Files can be translated manually or using pre-translate with a translation memory and machine translation suggestions.

Once complete, the original COTI archive is automatically rebuilt with the translated files. The archive file is a zip format with a .coti extension.

The completed COTI archive is then uploaded back to the exchange folder. The CMS detects this upload, unpacks the COTI archive, and imports the translation.

### Email Templates and Submitter Portal Macros (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709617392540-Email-Templates-and-Submitter-Portal-Macros-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-24T06:14:02Z  
> Labels: Automation, Administration, 2BTr, ar_tms

Email templates are used for the automatic notification of users such as notifying linguists or vendors about new jobs or notifying project managers when a job is marked as *Completed*. Templates are applied when [defining an automated project](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-2558de58-eb7e-d298-f22a-d41dd17b1de6 "Automated Project Creation - APC (TMS)").

Template macros can be used for the emails. Basic HTML formatting tags can be used to modify the templates. Templates cannot contain arbitrary hyperlinks. Only links inserted via Phrase-managed macros are supported.

##### Note

Templates containing hyperlinks cannot be edited and saved. Delete the hyperlinks from the template to save it.

The first email template available for automated notifications is selected.

To modify an email template, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682289822108) page, scroll down to the Administration section and click on Email templates.

   The Email templates page opens.
2. Click on the name of a template.

   The Edit email template page opens.
3. Modify the template as required and click Save.

   The changes are applied to the selected template.

#### Supported Email and Submitter Portal Macros

These can be used in [email templates](https://support.phrase.com#UUID-ab9ad063-eb5e-9a11-a4b4-78c673051419 "Email Templates and Submitter Portal Macros (TMS)") and [submitter portal](https://help.memsource.com/hc/en-us/articles/360012215079) templates.

Some macros are specific and can be used only in specific templates and in specific places. Test templates before using.

The `{comment}` and `{job.commentUrl}` macros are supported only in the New Mention or Comment in Job email template. These macros do not return any text when used in other email templates, including Job Assigned.

No macro exists to insert Project Notes into job-related email templates such as Job Assigned. To provide project-specific instructions in job emails, create a separate Job Assigned email template for each project type that requires different instructions, or add the extra text manually when sending the email from the project page. Adding extra text to an email is not available when sending it from the Jobs page.

All macros must be enclosed in curly brackets (e.g. `{apcName}`).

##### Job Assigned

- Launched manually by a Project Manager by clicking on Tools and selecting Email... in a project, or sent automatically upon the creation of a new job that has the Notify providers option enabled.
- This email is sent to the Linguist(s) or Vendor(s), giving notification regarding the availability of new translation job(s).

```

```

```
We have new work for you:

{jobInfo}
File: {job.name}
Language: {job.sourceLang} -> {job.targetLang}
Due: {job.dateDue}
{/jobInfo}

Sign in to Phrase to get started:
{project.url}

Let me know, if you have any questions.

{sender.firstName} {sender.lastName}
```

- [Workflow](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-3d4fec12-4a9f-ace5-cd20-a1575786a6b7) hierarchical structure are applied in relation to the propagation of segments.

##### Login Info

- When a new user is added to an organization, an email will be sent to them automatically which contains their username and a link for creating a password. The automatic email sent upon a user creation follows a specific template, due to GDPR, and cannot be customized. In case of organizations with [SSO](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5784117127580#UUID-e03be95d-94c2-a36f-04d5-99fa2c5c6d55) enabled, the email does not contain the link for creating a password.

  However, a Project Manager can also send login credentials manually by selecting a user in the Users page and clicking on the Email login button. The email template for this action can be customized in organization settings.
- An email with the user's username and the login link is sent. The user then generates a new password with the link provided.

```

```

Suggested name:

```

```

```
your login info:

Username: {recipient.userName}
Sign in at: {system.url.passwordReset}
(This will start the process of password creation.)

Let me know, if you have any questions.

Best regards,

{sender.firstName} {sender.lastName}
{sender.email}
```

### Continuous Analysis (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/17246425155996-Continuous-Analysis-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-07-21T10:13:51Z  
> Labels: Automation, Financials, 2BTr, cadence-dec24

#### Available for

- Team, Professional, Business, Enterprise and Software UI/UX plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Continuous Analysis is an option available for [Continuous Projects](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703661468#UUID-2bd6e968-44df-ca0a-4eec-583c56016cba) ensuring that the word count calculation is synced with the continuous workflows.

It automatically generates [analyses](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-7ed2ed16-6064-f667-bb86-7d971d7004c9) with every source update, with information about open and completed work based on [APC](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-2558de58-eb7e-d298-f22a-d41dd17b1de6 "Automated Project Creation - APC (TMS)") monitoring type and frequency.

Users can set up continuous analyses when configuring the APC for continuous projects. Default settings of the Continuous Analysis are a combination of the default, mandatory settings of the Post-Editing Analysis and the Default Analysis.

![cont_analysis_setup.jpeg](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682289874332)

Existing continuous analyses are displayed in the Financials tab of the specific APC page and can be downloaded and shared with a vendor in .JSON format.

![financials_tab.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682307124892)

Continuous Analysis consists of two types of information:

- Open work

  - Shows word count needing translation as of the latest source update.
  - Generated for schedule-based monitorings (24-hour, daily, weekly, monthly) but not for minute-based or webhook-based monitorings.
  - Architecturally based on default analysis.
- Completed work (Translated)

  - Displays word counts translated between source updates, grouped by [translation memory](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75) (TM) match categories.
  - Includes two sections:

    - Translated (Total):

      The word count that has been translated since the beginning of the project
    - Translated (Last Update):

      The word count that has been translated between the previous and most recent source updates.
  - Architecturally based on post-editing analysis.

**Scope and Limitations**

The scope depends on APC monitoring type:

| Monitoring configured | Information included |
| --- | --- |
| Schedule-based (<24h) | Completed Work only |
| Schedule-based (≥24h) | Completed Work and Open Work |
| Webhook-based | Completed Work only |
| Two monitorings:  1. Schedule-based (≥24h) 2. Webhook-based | - Completed Work with every source update - Open Work only for source updates triggered by the schedule-based monitoring |
| Two monitorings:  1. Schedule-based (<24h) 2. Webhook-based | Completed Work only |

## CAT Editors

Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/5709699926684-CAT-Editors

### CAT Editor (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964-CAT-Editor-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-30T06:06:51Z  
> Labels: Linguist, 2BTr, edited_at

The CAT editor is where linguists perform translation activities on assigned jobs and can manage the [job status](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557816092#UUID-31d37245-0c81-4869-f9f6-31b5cd66d2af). Assigned jobs are listed in the [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-f3d84af4-6f87-460d-3d81-594a257660ac) and can be downloaded from there.

##### Note

Depending on settings, use of the CAT editor will consume MTUs on capacity-based plans, and credits on credit-based plans. This [consumption can be managed](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/11530492252444#UUID-3c8ba1b3-290a-5451-ba45-71797af5a755) to balance requirements with cost.

For training resources, see our [webinars](https://phrase.com/resources/webinars/) (registration required).

There are two versions of the editor:

- [CAT web editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683890204#UUID-3584fbf3-588d-9380-14f0-3a8a1d6d4e9f "CAT Web Editor (TMS)")
- [CAT desktop editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683873052#UUID-7a11652d-34fd-bb63-cc40-98043737ed4a "CAT Desktop Editor (TMS)")

  ### Important

  The CAT desktop editor entered maintenance mode in October 2025. Only critical and security fixes are provided, and no further regular version releases are scheduled. The CAT web editor is recommended for access to the latest features.

The editor features standard functions such as text [filtering](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709720416796#UUID-11936659-047d-2507-3e91-ab2208f2ef73) **Ctrl+Shift+F**, find and replace text **Ctrl+H**, spellchecking **F7** (for [supported languages](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709608511516#UUID-f1a81c89-2772-5753-48fd-c2fa032e78db)), and [auto-complete](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700246940#UUID-eec64576-33db-b8f7-6f42-218a6efacf33 "Auto-complete (TMS)") and depending on settings, adding [terms](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-93902efd-b7e0-2dc0-8032-6643b2f369a8). If not restricted by an administrator, jobs can be downloaded from the Document menu in [bilingual .DOCX](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688974620#UUID-adb08905-9ca5-55e5-3739-95bd935275ea) or [.MXLIFF](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709739992860#UUID-03e9320f-57b2-e624-e8c7-9b3d2a3da55e) formats.

The editor is divided into working areas, or panes:

- [CAT pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683926812#UUID-4c833ac1-32c2-c1cb-2d80-b6411f03a8be "CAT Pane (TMS)")
- [Search pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700079644#UUID-fb05438c-797b-d6d7-4b83-e4f8c32f41ed "Concordance Search Pane (TMS)")
- [Quality assurance pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709694857372#UUID-1865a53c-d82a-4b2e-6209-aa12c86b50d3 "Quality Assurance Pane - QA (TMS)")
- [Changes pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700120476#UUID-5bf661bf-3e7f-4a72-4ff6-350a4aa4eb1a "Translation Changes Pane (TMS)")
- [Comments pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700374044#UUID-66a5d3b1-a562-dc5d-7289-3a789e5d9aa3 "Comments (TMS)")
- [Language quality assessment pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709599557020#UUID-071f9a72-20ef-1bcd-9169-14a46ebe0449)
- [Resources pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/28913499477532#UUID-06e59b69-e56f-5295-66ca-9d882effe248 "Resources Pane (TMS)")
- [In-Context preview](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709664002076#UUID-0450c3a1-d09c-321a-c074-12b897874631 "In-Context Preview (TMS)")
- [More pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709677966108#UUID-d13d4338-90e2-a0ce-98c8-d8f91e026f1f "More Languages Pane (TMS)")
- [Context note](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700187292#UUID-9b434e9f-9196-5411-83a1-5c07ac1b056b "Context Information (TMS)")

If reference files are associated with a project, they will be indicated by a paper clip ![paperclip.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682183566748) in the resource status indicators.

#### Appearance Preferences

To set appearance preferences such as color themes and font sizes, follow these steps:

1. From the menu ![Open Menu](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682183594652), select Preferences.

   The Preferences window opens.
2. Select the Appearance tab.

   Available options:

   - Theme (CAT web editor)
   - Language
   - Translation table

     - Adjust the font size, or select options for displaying segment background and QA issues in the translation table.
   - Color for hidden characters

     Hidden characters (e.g. whitespace characters) are displayed in the selected color when the option Format/Show hidden characters is enabled from the menu ![Open Menu](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682183594652).
   - Origin color of MT suggestions Origin color of NTs

     - Default: The purple origin color for MT and NT backgrounds is used (irrespective of score).
     - Score-based: The coloring is based on score for MT and NT; green (101/100), orange (fuzzy).
   - Panels
3. Select required options and click **Save**.

   Appearance preferences are saved for the editor.

#### Misc Preferences

To set Misc preferences, follow these steps:

1. From the menu ![Open Menu](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682183594652) , select Preferences.

   The PREFERENCES window opens.
2. Select the Misc tab.

   Available options:

   - Auto-complete
   - [Instant QA](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709694857372#UUID-1865a53c-d82a-4b2e-6209-aa12c86b50d3_UUID-e79510ca-6903-0bb3-6196-8b2b53df172e "Instant QA")
   - Multiple instances of the Editor for Desktop (Editor for Desktop only)
3. Click Save.

   Misc preferences are saved for the editor.

#### Status Bar

The status bar at the bottom of the editor provides metadata related to word counts, user modifications, and the source file name. User information displayed is based on project settings.

- Segments

  - Total number of segments/confirmed segments.
- Words

  - Total source words/confirmed source words (For CJK languages with no space between words, the number of words will equal the number of characters excluding punctuation marks).
- Chars

  - The first set of numbers is the total source characters/confirmed source characters. The second set is the character count for the source/target in the selected segment.

A detailed word count including 100% matches, fuzzy matches, etc., is provided by an [analysis](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-7ed2ed16-6064-f667-bb86-7d971d7004c9) from within a project.

#### Editor Resource Status (TMS)

The resource status indicators provide information about if and how the editor is connected to translation resources.

The indicators are presented in the *bottom right* of the Editor for Desktop and the *top right* of the Editor for Web.

###### Common error messages

**No connection (Editor for Desktop)**

- Ensure the server address (cloud.memsource.com, or the one provided by the Project Manager) is correct.
- Check the [proxy settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683873052#UUID-7a11652d-34fd-bb63-cc40-98043737ed4a_UUID-d0a2d27b-cb9c-2a86-429e-139ccc132cf1 "Login Preferences").
- Check your Internet connection.
- Use Winmtr (free download for Windows) to check the route from your computer to our server. Ensure your ISP is not re-routing your connection via too many servers and slowing it down.

**Invalid username and/or password (**Editor for Desktop**)**

- Check your username and password.

  Try to log in to your Linguist Portal with the same credentials.

  If password is forgotten, [create a new one](https://support.phrase.com/document/preview/7928#UUID-bddb003f-dc32-06ed-f92f-75c473c51ee7).

**Unknown Error (**Editor for Desktop**)**

- Lost connection to the server. Check internet connection.

**Login is Green but All Other Indicators are Red (**Editor for Desktop**)**

- User profile was deactivated by the PM.

**Server not responding (**Editor for Desktop**)**

When trying to Run QA checks.

- Check the login indicators.

  Alternatively, upload a file to the server (click on Document and selecting Upload to server), and check the error message in the bottom right-hand corner.

**Other errors (**CAT desktop editor**)**

Error Log

- The editor saves a log file on your local disk.

  Look for a folder *.memsource*, subfolder *logs*.

  In Windows, this can be located in `C:\Users\your Windows username\.memsource\logs`

  On Mac, it is in `/Users/username/.memsource/logs` (`.memsource` is a hidden folder, the shortcut **SHIFT** + **CMD** + **.** can display it).

  If contacting support, attach this log to the request.

**You are not authorized to access this job**

- The job was removed from the server by the Project Manager (PM)—contact the PM.
- The job was assigned to another Linguist—contact the PM.
- You are trying to access a job using an incorrect username (if you have more than one).

**TM, TB, or MT are Gray**

- They are not attached to the project in question or enabled for the given target language. This could be intentional—contact the PM if unsure.
- Some [MT engines](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709646851740#UUID-66275530-6db6-1347-e6a8-3d1cfa735d96) support only batch pre-translation and do not return real-time suggestions in the CAT pane. When such an engine is assigned, the CAT pane displays a message indicating that the MT engine is available for batch pre-translation only. To view MT suggestions in the CAT pane while translating, select a different MT engine in the project's MT profile, one that supports real-time suggestions. Alternatively, run pre-translation on the job to populate segments with MT suggestions before editing.

**Error at 95% (or 97%)**

When Uploading the Translation: Error at 95% (or 97%), Unable to upload translation— Access denied.

- Job not accepted - Go to Linguist Portal and change the status.
- The job is set to Completed—access no longer allowed. Contact the PM.
- The job was assigned to another Linguist. Contact the PM.

### CAT Desktop Editor (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683873052-CAT-Desktop-Editor-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-29T06:06:56Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, edited_at

#### Available for

- All paid plans

##### Important

Starting in October 2025, the CAT desktop editor enters maintenance mode:

- Only critical and security fixes will be provided.
- No regular new version releases will be scheduled.
- There are no plans to fully sunset the desktop editor at this time.

As of November 25, 2025:

- The minimum version will be set to 25.9.0. Earlier versions will no longer be able to login to Phrase to work with online files.
- An in-app prompt requesting approval to use the CAT Desktop Editor may appear. [Admins or Project Managers](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5793349215900#UUID-09f99b48-09c7-b144-42bb-a1bfd2e7d452) can request access on behalf of their users by contacting Phrase Technical Support or their Customer Success Manager.

As separate TMS SAML SSO is no longer available, single sign-on is no longer supported.

[Download](https://phrase.com/download/) the latest version to use with an updated OS.

The CAT desktop editor is a lightweight CAT tool that can be installed on current manufacturer supported Windows, Macintosh, and Linux operating systems. Minimum requirements are a processor (CPU) not more than 8 years old, 2GB of RAM and at least 256 MB of disk storage. While [translating offline](https://support.phrase.com#UUID-7a11652d-34fd-bb63-cc40-98043737ed4a_UUID-ab1c8d8e-e734-f4fa-86c3-2f83c56e57d7 "Translating Offline") is supported, full functionality is provided when connected.

Panes in the editor can be moved outside the main window to give more visibility. To place the panes back in their original positions, select Restore default layout from the Tools menu.

[.MXLIFF](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709739992860#UUID-03e9320f-57b2-e624-e8c7-9b3d2a3da55e) files are the native file format for the editor and can be downloaded from translation projects.

The editor automatically connects to the translation memory (TM), term base (TB), and machine translation (MT) resources attached to the project for the given language pair when logged in. If no TM, TB, or MT is connected to the project, the resource icons appear grayed out.

For supported versions, see the [download](https://phrase.com/download/) site.

#### Installation for Windows

As of October 24, 2023 Windows (32-bit) is no longer supported. The minimum supported Windows (64-bit) version is 10.

To install CAT desktop editor, follow these steps:

1. Double-click the downloaded installation file.

   The installation launches.
2. When installation completes, open the editor.
3. From the Tools menu, under Preferences, select the Login tab.

   The Login tab opens.
4. Enter login details:

   - Server - typically *cloud.memsource.com* for the EU data center and *us.cloud.memsource.com* for the US data center
   - Username

     Unlike the web editor, this must be the username and not the email address.
   - Password
5. Click Save.

   Login credentials are saved. If correct, the Login indicator will show green.

#### Installation for Mac

Supported versions are macOS 11 and higher.

Follow these steps:

1. Navigate to System Preferences and select Security & Privacy settings.
2. In the Allow apps downloaded from users section, select App Store and identified developers.

   Administrator privileges required.
3. With Security & Privacy settings still open, unzip the installer and launch it. The installer will be blocked, but will appear in Security & Privacy settings
4. In Security & Privacy settings, click Open anyway.

   The installer launches.
5. When installation completes, open the editor.
6. From the Tools menu, under Preferences, select the Login tab.

   The Login tab opens.
7. Enter login details:

   - Server - typically *cloud.memsource.com* for the EU data center and *us.cloud.memsource.com* for the US data center
   - Username
   - Password
8. Click Save.

   Login credentials are saved. If correct, the Login indicator will show green.

#### Installation for Ubuntu

The minimum supported Ubuntu (64-bit) version is 22.04. The 32-bit version is not supported.

To install the CAT desktop editor, follow these steps:

1. Right click on downloaded file and select Properties.
2. Select the Permissions tab.
3. Select the Execute box (Allow Executing File as Program).

   The software installer will pop up to complete the installation.

When new versions are released, the editor displays the Application update window, where users can choose to download them in the background. The upgraded version will be opened when restarted. Updates are backwards compatible but if any issues occur, logging in to the project (with the same profile that you are using to log in to the editor) and downloading a fresh version of the bilingual MXLIFF file may solve the problem.

#### Login Preferences

To set or change login preferences, follow these steps:

1. From the Tools menu, select Preferences.

   The Preferences windows opens.
2. Select the Login tab.

   Provide, change or remove login details.
3. Click Save.

   Login details are applied.

Login credentials for different [organizations](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/6091807042076#UUID-3b204035-bb79-8662-cb38-a08bb599962b) are saved. There is no ability to switch organizations within the desktop editor; if a user is a member of multiple organizations, they will only be able to use the desktop editor under the default organization. Selecting the username for a specific organization applies the preferences for that organization. If not in use, or invalid, user credentials can be deleted.

After a password reset, the Desktop Editor may continue to retry cached old credentials automatically, which can cause an "Incorrect username or password" error even when the correct new password is entered. If this occurs, open the Login tab, select the saved username, remove the stored credentials, and save. Then enter the username and new password again and save. If the error persists, close the Desktop Editor completely, delete the local .memsource folder, and log in again with the new password.

**Single Sign-On (SSO)**

As separate TMS SAML SSO is no longer available, single sign-on is no longer supported.

#### Network Preferences

To set or change network preferences, follow these steps:

1. From the Tools menu, select Preferences.

   The Preferences window opens.
2. Select the Misc tab.

   The Network section is displayed at the bottom of the window.
3. If the proxy requires manual configuration, click the Configure proxy manually radio button.

   Provide proxy type, server name and authentication details. These should be provided by a network administrator.
4. Click Save.

   Network details are saved.

#### Translating Offline

The CAT desktop editor can be used to work offline but access to translation resources such as TMs, TBs, machine translation and QA will be limited. The preview feature is also only available while online.

It is recommended to be connected to the internet when using the editor but if connection is not possible, the following process can be used to work offline.

To prepare a job for working offline, follow these steps:

1. Install the editor.
2. From the [linguist portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709735838492#UUID-911ee8d4-ecc1-0c38-8f71-7c22f1646545), [pre-translate](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717749788#UUID-a982e5f9-9aa2-434f-116c-17b822d35343) the .MXLIFF file.
3. Download the pre-translated .MXLIFF file and begin translating in the editor.

   Segments with TM matches are pre-translated.
4. Go offline if required and continue translating.

##### Tip

Make backups of .MXLIFF files as well as any other important documents at regular intervals in line with the general best practices for offline work. Refer to clients' data protection policies e. g. on the mandatory use of encryption on external drives.

To go back online with the job, follow these steps:

1. Log in.

   [Resource status](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-1da30c04-11f8-6314-17a0-f4948f4cfed6_UUID-97b3e31d-4d68-7046-1abe-ddfeafdecd9b "Editor Resource Status (TMS)") will show green.
2. Upload the .MXLIFF file with one of these methods:

   - From the Document menu, select Upload to server.
   - From the linguist portal Tools menu, select Upload.
   - Send the file to the Project manager for upload.
3. Complete the translation.

##### .MXLIFF Upload Problems

The [editor resource status](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-1da30c04-11f8-6314-17a0-f4948f4cfed6 "CAT Editor (TMS)") provides detailed information about error messages during upload.

- **The MXLIFF is broken.**

  - May occur if the file was translated in a CAT tool other than Phrase.
- **The MXLIFF belongs to a different project.**

  - A workflow error; a translator creates their own projects and then tries to add their .MXLIFF files to a client profile.
- **The MXLIFF belongs to a different workflow step.**

  - The .MXLIFF file should always be added to the same workflow step that it was exported from.
- **The job has been deleted.**

  - The job into which the .MXLIFF file belongs has been deleted, but the translator has continued to translate the deleted .MXLIFF file. Because the job was deleted, the connection between the server and the .MXLIFF file was lost (connections cannot be made to deleted jobs). The translator was working offline when the job was deleted and the resource status was showing red.
  - The PM can locate the deleted job in the recycle bin and [undelete](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709704092572#UUID-1e37e39c-e4a8-3f6b-fd8f-4a1e11ed0265) it.

### CAT Web Editor (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683890204-CAT-Web-Editor-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-11T11:50:21Z  
> Labels: 2BTr

The CAT web editor is the web-based translation workbench. It does not require any installation, but users must be connected to the internet to use it and the project manager must have the CAT web editor for Web enabled for Linguists option enabled in the Access and security section of the project setup.

The editor is opened by clicking a job from the [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420#UUID-33f88350-daa8-2ab2-e7ce-e35300ec60f8) or from a project. Jobs open in new browser tabs.

The size of the editor UI is affected by the browser's zoom settings and may vary depending on how much the user zooms in or out.

The editor is limited to a maximum of 150,000 segments that can be translated in one window and a maximum of 290 open jobs.

[Complex filtering and customized quotation marks](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709720416796#UUID-11936659-047d-2507-3e91-ab2208f2ef73) are available in the CAT web editor.

The CAT web editor aligns with international accessibility standards, including the [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/wcag/) (WCAG).

#### Input Methods for CJK Languages

A wide range of input methods can be used for inserting Chinese, Japanese, and Korean characters. These range from official to custom-made input methods.

The editor supports the following input methods:

- Chinese OS Default
- Chinese Sogou
- Japanese OS Default
- Korean 2-beolsik

Other input methods may not be fully supported. Before reporting any problems with CJK in the editor, ensure one of the supported input methods is being used.

##### Note

Error-free results are not guaranteed for [Google Input Tools](https://www.google.com/inputtools/). Before reporting any issues, try using standard input method editors (IMEs).

#### Web Editor Font Restrictions

##### Arabic fonts

Older versions of Chrome and Safari don't support the proper rendering of Arabic characters.

Upgrade to the newest version of Chrome or Safari or switch to Mozilla Firefox, where it works correctly.

##### Burmese fonts

Windows 10 fully supports Burmese fonts, but older versions do not.

If unable to upgrade, the following fonts offer restricted workarounds:

- **Myanmar text**

  The is the default for Windows but is not working properly.
- **Zawgyi-One**

  Free for download, and less problematic than Myanmar text.
- **Myanmar3**

  The best option, but a paid application (font and keyboard), and difficult to install.

There are two options if choosing Zawgyi-One to work with:

- Set it in Chrome as the default font in order to use all online features of the editor. Rendering is not perfect and may be difficult to read.
- Download the bilingual .DOCX and translate it in Word using the Zawgyi-One font. With this method, the Linguist will not be able to use online features such as the translation memory, QA checks, or term bases.

##### Tip

PowerPoint does not allow users to change fonts in files that have already been translated into Burmese.

Open the original in PowerPoint, change the font to Zawgyi-One, save it, and then import it as a new job. The completed file will then have the correct font.

#### Error Messages - CAT Web Editor

##### Failed to save segment # due to an internal error

The project is in the Completed status. This prevents a linguist from saving segments as the project is technically finished and jobs are closed for further editing. Contact the person (project manager or admin), who assigned the job and ask them to change the project status from Completed to either New, Assigned, or Accepted so the job can be edited.

![JobStatus_Completed.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682216363036)

### CAT Pane (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683926812-CAT-Pane-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-24T06:07:02Z  
> Labels: 2BTr

The Computer Assisted Translation (CAT) pane ![CAT Pane](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682197429788) displays [segmented](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709678012828#UUID-0d65fa6f-a518-11dc-7467-b46c79496b52 "Segments (TMS)") source text alongside matches from translation memories, term bases, and machine translation after [pre-translation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717749788#UUID-a982e5f9-9aa2-434f-116c-17b822d35343). Non-translatables are also displayed.

The CAT pane retrieves matches and suggestions from the currently available translation resources. Information from previously used resources that are no longer enabled for the project cannot be provided.

Double-click a suggestion or use **CTRL+Number** to apply it to the target text. CAT results can also be moved using **CTRL+ArrowDown** and **CTRL+ArrowUp**. To insert the currently selected suggestion to the target segment, use **CTRL+Space**.

To see more information about a segment in the lower window, click on the segment in the CAT pane.

Hovering over information in the bottom window provides more detail.

##### Note

If a *target language* Term has a Note or Usage information, it is tagged with an asterisk (**\***).

#### CAT Result Ordering

CAT results are displayed in the following order and are color coded:

1. Light green - Best translation memory, non-translatable or machine translation suggestion based on the score.
2. Orange - Term base items (If there is a preferred term it will be placed at top.)
3. Salmon - Translation memory, non-translatable, or machine translation suggestion based on scores.
4. Light purple - Machine translations (with no QPS score).
5. Grey - Sub-segment TM (**S**).

![CAT_pane_matches.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682216518940)

#### Translation Memory Matches

- **101%** - An in-context translation memory match.

  A greater than a 100% match indicates the context also matches what is saved in the TM.
- **100%** - An exact translation memory match.
- **78%** - A fuzzy translation memory match (anything below 100%).
- **S** - A subsegment match.

  If a smaller part of the original text was previously translated as a short segment, the CAT pane will display it even though the match is lower than the threshold set in the Editor's Preference.
- The downward arrow (**↓**) indicates TM penalization.

  A project manager can set penalties for low quality TM matches in order to ensure they are reviewed. 100% matches, for example, may be shown as 95% matches.

When two or more translation memories assigned to a project contain the same or an equivalent match for a segment, the CAT pane displays only the match from the TM with the higher priority. The match from the lower-priority TM does not appear automatically, even at 100%, and requires a manual concordance search to locate.

Adjust the order of translation memories in the project's TM settings to change which TM takes precedence. Availability of TM priority configuration depends on the subscription plan.

The match displayed reflects the priority order of the translation memories assigned to the project rather than the highest match percentage across all assigned TMs. Reorder translation memories in the project's translation memory settings to promote a different TM's match to the CAT pane. This option may not be available on all subscription plans.

When a translation memory match is selected, details are displayed at the bottom of the pane. Clicking the name of the translation memory opens the translation memory page in a new browser tab, already searched to show the selected match. From there, the match can be reviewed, edited, or deleted.

The translation memory name is a link only for users in the same organization as the translation memory. In shared projects and jobs, users from other organizations see the name as plain text.

Linguists without the Edit translations in TM permission can open the translation memory page and view the match but cannot edit or delete it.

#### Term Base Matches

- **TB** indicates a suggested term from a term base.
- **TB** in yellow indicates a *New* term that has not yet been approved.
- **TB** in yellow with bold characters indicates an *Approved* term.
- A term in red indicates a term that has been rejected and should not be used during translation.

When a term is selected, details are displayed at the bottom of the pane. Clicking on Edit source or Edit target, opens the [Edit term](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10112323818908#UUID-bb305d9b-6f26-da20-eaf3-ee546aba0500) page.

If a term base contains specific language locales, only terms available for the given locales are offered in jobs matching those locales.

**Example:**

A term base contains `FR`, `FR_FR`, and `FR_CA`.

The job contains only `FR_FR`.

Only terms available in `FR_FR` are displayed.

If a term base has a language without locales, terms from this language are also offered also in jobs with a locale.

**Example:**

A term base contains `FR`.

These terms are suggested for both `FR` and `FR_FR` jobs.

If an exact multi-word term exists in the term base, it appears in the CAT pane, while single-word terms are ignored.

If a single-word term is part of a multi-word term, only the multi-word term is displayed in the CAT pane. This helps display the most relevant terms, prioritizing multi-word terms for better consistency while avoiding unnecessary single-word suggestions.

Fuzzy matching for term base entries accounts only for a suffix added to the end of a term (for example, "car" also matches "cars") or a word stem variation up to 6 characters past a defined stem boundary. It does not account for a new word inserted between existing words in a multi-word term, as this is a structural change rather than a morphological one. To ensure such variants are matched, add them as separate term entries in the term base.

#### Non-translatables

A non-translatable (NT) is text that does not require translation. Phrase identifies these texts and suggests them as NTs.

NTs are AI-based; an algorithm working in the background identifies them based on specified criteria. NT segments usually contain characters, symbols, and words that do not need to be translated such as numbers, formulas, code, email addresses, currency, human and product names. As it is AI-based, it is not possible to rule out any inconsistencies as the algorithm identifying the NTs is continuously being improved upon based on gathered data.

Depending on AI accuracy, the NT is either 100% or 99% and are likely to be a segment not requiring translation but should still be reviewed by a linguist.

Display of the NT score in the editor is optional and there are two settings:

- NT with no score displayed with a white background in the score column and CAT pane
- NT with score displayed as dash underlined green 100 or orange 99 in the score column and the CAT pane

To see match details:

- Hover over the underlined score.
- Click on the match in the CAT pane.

#### Machine Translation and QPS Matches

Upon clicking on a segment, MT suggestions are triggered in the CAT pane both for the current segment and for its four subsequent segments.

##### Note

If the CAT pane does not display MT suggestions for a segment and shows the message "The selected MT engine is available for batch pre-translation only," the assigned MT engine supports batch pre-translation only and does not provide real-time suggestions. To enable real-time MT suggestions in the CAT Editor, select a different engine in the [MT profile](https://support.phrase.com/document/preview/21505#UUID-8139f165-9c79-2540-f81a-e117c38aad03).

Refer to [Specific MT Engine Restrictions](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709646851740#UUID-66275530-6db6-1347-e6a8-3d1cfa735d96) for a list of engines that support batch pre-translation only.

If enabled, the [QPS](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709672289180#UUID-054981cd-9a0e-32bf-79b7-cd6167ebf444) feature enables users to analyze a job and provides a percentage score for machine translation suggestions at the segment level before any post-editing is done.

##### Quality Scores

Scoring categories:

- 95 - 100: Excellent

  The highest level of translation quality. Excellent translations are fluent, accurate and stylistically appropriate.
- 90 -94: Very good

  A high-quality translation with limited room for improvement. Very good translations capture the content of the source and articulate it well in target.
- 75 - 89: Good

  A good translation of source content, with room to improve the fluency and stylistic expression of the target text.
- 0 - 74: Poor

  A poor translation may fail to communicate source content with sufficient accuracy and clarity.

#### CAT Pane Preferences

To set CAT Pane preferences, follow these steps:

1. Select Preferences from the menu ![Open Menu](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682216549532).

   The Preferences windows opens.
2. Select the CAT tab.

   Available options:

   - Translation memory (TM)

     Set the Minimum match rate for translation memory matches to be displayed and used for pre-translations.
   - After confirming a segment, jump to the

     Select the desired behavior after confirming a segment.
   - Pre-translate

     - Enable/disable the auto-propagation of repetitions.

       Admins and Project managers can decide if the translations of repeated source text segments are automatically inserted into the corresponding target text segments. They can also choose whether Linguist users can control this setting.

       See [access and security](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82).
     - Set pre-translate options to control the behavior of pre-translating the next segment that the user jumps to after confirming a segment.
     - If machine translation is available for a project, Insert MT will pre-translate segments with machine translation when a translation memory match above the minimum specified threshold is not available.
3. Click Save.

   CAT preferences are saved for the editor.

Concordance search is useful for finding matches that contain a single word or phrase, rather than an entire segment. [Wildcard search](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733449372#UUID-2a4c8798-761f-051a-255c-f1faf84196e6) is supported.

The Concordance Search pane can be accessed via:

- Selecting the Concordance Search ![Search_pane.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682167011100) pane in the side panel.
- Selecting a string and using the keyboard shortcut **CTRL+K** for search or **CTRL+SHIFT+K** for exact search (in quotation marks).

Click on a search result to present relevant metadata and context information in the lower pane.
