### Google Drive (TMS, Studio)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709642759708-Google-Drive-TMS-Studio  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-21T11:23:56Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- All paid plans

##### Important

The Google Drive (Legacy) connector will be **deprecated** on **November 30, 2026**. New instances of this connector can be created until August 17, 2026. Migrate to the new connector before the deprecation date.

Refer to [Legacy Connector Deprecation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/28590922139676#UUID-82bf558b-d132-4073-b91c-e25dfef2cdd8 "Legacy Connector Deprecation") for a full migration guide.

Google Drive is a cloud-based file storage and synchronization service designed to integrate with most operating systems and devices, sync content in real-time across multiple devices, and act as a backup data repository for data.

Google Drive connector allows the downloading of source files and uploading of target files directly to/from personal and shared Google Drive repositories.

The connector cannot access folders in a *shared drive* if the authenticated account is not a member of it. If a folder in a shared drive is not accessible after creating a Google Drive connector, add the Google account used for authentication as a member of that shared drive.

Files shared by other users and present in the Shared with me section are not supported. Move or copy these files into a shared drive to make them accessible to the connector.

The connector uses the Google Drive API to implement the integration.

When a Google Drive connector is configured and authorized in Phrase TMS, the same connection is automatically available in other Phrase products that support external content browsing via Google Drive. Source files can be selected, content can be imported and translated files can be exported back to Google Drive without reauthentication wherever the connector appears in the interface.

[Eingebettetes Video/Inhalt](https://www.youtube.com/embed/lj1jQNthxUM)

##### Note

Due to continuous improvements, the user interface may not be exactly the same as presented in the video.

###### Google Docs Support

Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Slides use specialized file formats that Phrase does not support. The connector converts these file types to .docx, .xlsx, or .pptx, respectively, for processing. When a translation of those types of files is completed and uploaded back to Google Drive, they are automatically converted back into their native Google format.

Google Drive cannot export Google files (Docs, Sheets, Slides) over a certain size (approximately 10 MB) due to a limitation in the Google API. The error The file is too large to be exported is triggered and the job will not be created. In this case, download the file and upload it to manually.

#### Use Cases

There are a number of use cases for the connector:

- Project managers can add files directly to projects from an online repository.
- Set up the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76) to allow Submitters to add files to requests directly from the online repository.
- Use [automated project creation (APC)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) to have new projects automatically created when a change in the **last modified date** is detected for monitored files or a folder.

  - This connector supports absolute path setting.
- Set up [continuous jobs](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709711922972#UUID-ec063437-ae86-bb7b-9358-19bb3087a3c5) to have selected files monitored for changes.

#### Google Drive Settings

No changes are required.

#### Phrase TMS Settings

##### Important

If accessing from a custom domain (ex. `mydomain.phrase.jp`), open an incognito browser window and log in via `cloud.memsource.com` or `us.cloud.memsource.com` to apply the authentication required for the creation or saving of the connector. After saving, the connector can be accessed via the custom domain.

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682277107228) page, scroll down to the Integrations section.
2. Click on Connectors.

   The Connectors page opens.
3. Click New connector.

   The Create connector page opens.
4. Change the Type to *Google Drive* and provide a name for the connector.
5. Click Connect to Google Drive.

   A Google authentication screen will appear where you can select your account.
6. Click on Allow.

   A checkmark will appear in the connector setup if the connection was successful. A red exclamation point will appear if it wasn't. Hover over the icon to see additional details.
7. Click Save.

   The connector is added to the list on the Connectors page.

###### Delete a Connector

To delete a connector:

1. From the Integrations page, select the connector to delete.
2. Click Delete.

   The Delete connector window opens.
3. Type "delete" and click Delete.

   The connector is deleted and the list of connectors is displayed.

##### Note

A connector cannot be deleted while it is still linked to incomplete jobs in a project, including jobs sitting in the Recycle bin. Attempting to delete such a connector returns a "Failed to delete connector" error.

Resolution: Open the project associated with the connector and complete or delete any remaining jobs. Go to Settings/Recycle bin, and empty it to remove any jobs still linked to the connector. Retry deleting the connector.

##### Tip

Currently, only one connector per Google Drive account (including its personal and shared drives) may have valid authentication at a time.

To switch between connectors, or to add an additional Google connector to the same account and force its authentication, follow these steps:

1. Visit the Google Drive page.
2. Click on the account (top right corner)
3. Click **Security** on the left, and scroll down to *Third-party apps with account access*.
4. Click on **Manage third-party access**. If *Memsource Connector* is listed here, delete it.
5. Create a new connector to this Google Drive account with valid authentication.

To switch authentication between your existing connectors, go to the inactive connector's setup page and press *Re-connect to Google Drive.*

#### Google Drive Privacy Policy

By using this service, you agree that Phrase can access your Google Drive, browse files and folders, access and download selected files, upload the translated versions back to your Google Drive, and access and download native Google documents in your Google Drive. Phrase use of Google user data is limited to the practices explicitly disclosed in this privacy policy.

#### Google Drive Troubleshooting

###### Authentication or Internal Server error

If an authentication error or an Internal server error appears when saving a new Google Drive connector, and the same Google account is already linked to an older connector created before February 20, 2026, the cause is likely a legacy limitation in how the original authorization was stored.

Test connection usually succeeds, but the connector fails when selecting Save.

**Resolution**

1. Reset the Google authorization in the Google account to disconnect all existing Google Drive connectors associated with that account.
2. Reconnect the Google Drive connectors in Phrase by opening each connector that used this account and completing the authentication again.
3. Once reauthenticated, a new Google Drive connector can be created and saved successfully using the same Google account.

### HubSpot (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709638230428-HubSpot-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-28T06:23:59Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Team, Professional, Business and Enterprise plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

HubSpot connector allows the downloading of source content and uploading of translations to/from HubSpot Marketing Hub for the following content types:

- Website pages
- Landing pages
- Themes
- Blog posts
- Emails

  Emails built with HubSpot's module (drag-and-drop) editor are fully supported and their content is imported and segmented normally. Emails built with HubSpot's HTML editor are not supported by the connector. Only the Subject and Preheader fields are extracted for translation; the email body content is not imported.

  To translate an email built with the HTML editor, either download the email's HTML file from HubSpot and import it into Phrase as an .HTML file, or rebuild the email using HubSpot's module editor.
- Forms (only Embedded and Standalone page forms are supported due to API limitations)
- Files

HubSpot requires users connecting the integration to have App Marketplace permissions. If an error occurs, HubSpot recommends granting Super Admin permissions.

##### Note

`zh_hans_cn` and `zh_hant_tw` language codes are not supported by HubSpot and are mapped to `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant`, respectively.

#### Use Cases

There are a number of use cases for the connector:

- Project managers can add files directly to projects from an online repository. Only documents that match the connector's source language or don't have any language set are listed.
- Set up the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76) allowing Submitters to add files to requests directly from the online repository. Only documents that match the connector's source language or don't have any language set are listed.
- Use [automated project creation (APC)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) to have new projects automatically created when a change in the **last modified date** is detected for monitored files or a folder.

#### HubSpot Settings

No changes are required.

#### Phrase TMS Settings

##### Important

If accessing from a custom domain (ex. `mydomain.phrase.jp`), open an incognito browser window and log in via `cloud.memsource.com` or `us.cloud.memsource.com` to apply the authentication required for the creation or saving of the connector. After saving, the connector can be accessed via the custom domain.

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682210465308) page, scroll down to the Integrations section.
2. Click on Connectors.

   The Connectors page opens.
3. Click New connector.

   The Create connector page opens.
4. Change the Type to *HubSpot* and provide a name for the connector.
5. Click Connect to HubSpot.

   HubSpot login page opens.
6. Log in to HubSpot and select an account.

   ### Note

   Login via Google or Microsoft is not supported.

   A checkmark will appear in the connector setup if the connection was successful. A red exclamation point will appear if it wasn't. Hover over the icon to see additional details.
7. Import additional metadata for translation

   Customize the import with these metadata options:

   - Featured Image Alt Text

     Enable to include the `alt` attributes of featured images (e.g., on blog posts or landing pages) for translation. Alt text supports accessibility for screen readers and improves SEO by describing the image content to search engines.
   - Localizable Meta Fields

     Enable to import additional metadata content from HubSpot for translation.

     Supported fields include:

     - `meta.post_summary, meta.post_body, meta.description`
     - `post_summary, email_content, list_content`
     - `rssBody, rssSummary`

       This improves SEO and ensures a consistent multilingual experience.
   - Smart Content

     Enable to import all smart content variations (e.g., personalized CTAs or messages shown based on user attributes like location or lifecycle stage). This ensures each version is localized correctly.
   - head\_html Parameters

     Enable this to extract and localize custom HTML inserted in the `<head>` section of the page. This may include meta tags, tracking scripts, or linked styles that contain translatable strings.
   - Fields to Omit

     Specify content blocks to exclude from import by entering one or more path values.

     - To omit all fields starting with a specific path (e.g., `layoutSections.dnd_area.rows[0]`), enter that full prefix.
     - To omit fields that contain a value, prefix it with `*` (e.g., `*rssSummary`). Separate multiple paths with commas. Whitespace and line breaks are ignored.

       To identify the correct path, open the source file of a HubSpot job and check the path attribute in the div tags.
8. Choose how the target files are to be organized in HubSpot:

   - *As multi-language groups* - the translated pages are linked to the master page and form a language group. This option is supported for only Landing and Website pages. For more information, see [HubSpot documentation](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/cos-general/how-to-manage-multi-language-content-with-hubspots-cos).
   - *As separate documents* - the translated pages are stored as siblings. Language code appended to their internal page name differentiates the individual translations (e.g., Homepage vs. Homepage [de]).
9. Select publication status of translations.
10. Set the Source language.

    - This language must match the Source language of the project and should match the Primary language of the HubSpot site that's configured in HubSpot Domains & URLs settings.
11. Click Save.

    The connector is added to the list on the Connectors page.

###### Delete a Connector

To delete a connector:

1. From the Integrations page, select the connector to delete.
2. Click Delete.

   The Delete connector window opens.
3. Type "delete" and click Delete.

   The connector is deleted and the list of connectors is displayed.

##### Note

A connector cannot be deleted while it is still linked to incomplete jobs in a project, including jobs sitting in the Recycle bin. Attempting to delete such a connector returns a "Failed to delete connector" error.

Resolution: Open the project associated with the connector and complete or delete any remaining jobs. Go to Settings/Recycle bin, and empty it to remove any jobs still linked to the connector. Retry deleting the connector.

Joomla is a Content Management System (CMS) that allows users to create and maintain web content.

Joomla connector allows the downloading of articles and categories and uploading of translations to/from Joomla.

#### Supported Versions

Joomla 3.7 or higher.

**Supported Plugins**

- EasyBlog (posts only)

#### Use Cases

There are a number of use cases for the connector:

- Project managers can add files directly to projects from an online repository.
- Set up the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76) to allow Submitters to add files to requests directly from the online repository.

#### Joomla Settings

1. Install Multilingual Associations that are part of the System - Language Filter plugin.
2. [Download the Phrase connector](https://extensions.joomla.org/extension/memsource-connector/) and follow the installation instructions.
3. Go to the Components menu and select Phrase Connector.
4. Copy the Phrase Connector Token to the clipboard.

7. Click Test connection.

### Kontent.ai (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709668269340-Kontent-ai-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-21T11:23:58Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Business and Enterprise plans (not available for LSP plans)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Kontent.ai is a headless CMS providing the infrastructure to create and manage content. It is not coupled to any single presentation layer allowing the distribution of content to any platform or device.

All translatable fields are imported for localization unless flagged as non-localizable in Kontent.ai.

When exporting an article from TMS to Kontent.ai, ensure the article is not already published in Kontent.ai. Kontent.ai does not allow modifications to published content.

Translatable content elements:

- text
- rich text
- assets
- linked items

Translatable media assets are also supported. To access assets, select Assets as the Default folder when setting up the connector or as a folder to be monitored in [APC](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553). Target files are uploaded to locations defined in APC or [CJ](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709711922972#UUID-ec063437-ae86-bb7b-9358-19bb3087a3c5).

#### Use Cases

There are a number of use cases for the connector:

- Project managers can add files directly to projects from an online repository.
- Set up the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76) to allow Submitters to add files to requests directly from the online repository.
- Use [automated project creation (APC)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) to have new projects automatically created when a change in the specified workflow states is detected.
- The [connector API](https://cloud.memsource.com/web/docs/api) can be used to automate steps otherwise performed manually through the UI. [Webhooks](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709693398812#UUID-6a1bd917-264f-438d-8d66-2e32504779ec) can be used to have 3rd party systems notified about certain events (for example, a job status change).

#### Kontent.ai Settings

1. Log in to your Kontent.ai account and open the selected project.

   The Home page opens.
2. Navigate to Project Settings and click API Keys.
3. Copy the Project ID.

   The Project ID is required for the connector configuration and appears in the URL on any content page, except the Project settings page. This connector will only be able to browse and monitor this Kontent.ai Project. If another Project needs to be monitored, create a new connector with a new Project ID.
4. Copy the Management API Key.

   This key is required for the connector configuration. This key allows access to unpublished content items to be localized before publication.
5. Copy the Delivery API key.

   This key is required for the connector configuration.

#### Phrase TMS Settings

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682244165532) page, scroll down to the Integrations section.
2. Click on Connectors.

   The Connectors page opens.
3. Click New connector.

   The Create connector page opens.
4. Change the Type to Kentico.ai and provide a name for the connector.
5. Select how the connector should import linked content items.

   Remote Kontent.ai workflow steps are respected for linked items. If the selected content item is set to Translate, yet all linked items are in Draft they will not be imported. Selected items and their linked items both require the initial Translate workflow step to be imported by APC. This is ensure that only content that is explicitly intended to be localized by the content author is imported.

   - Selected content item only

     - Content that is explicitly selected when adding from the repository is imported.
     - Changes detected by APC are imported for translation.
   - Include linked content items

     - The connector traverses the entire hierarchy of linked content and imports all translatable fields for translation.
6. Enter Project ID obtained from the Kontent.ai site.
7. Enter Management API Key obtained from the Kontent.ai site.
8. Enter Preview API Key. This field should contain the Delivery API key obtained from the Kontent.ai site.
9. Provide Translate to languages specified in (APC).

   [Automated project creation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) will only create jobs for languages specified by codes in the given field that is specified by a unique ID (e.g. target\_languages). Codes can be followed by language names as long as they are separated by a comma (e.g. *de-DE German (Germany)*).

   Language codes are case insensitive and can use either \_ or formatting - (e.g. *de\_de*, *de-de*, *de-DE*).

   ### Note

   To select target languages on the content item level, create a new Taxonomy Group (Content Model > Taxonomies) within the selected Kontent.ai Project ID. The newly created group (e.g. Target Languages) should contain the language codes of all localization languages configured in the selected project. Add the configured taxonomy group to all or selected content models as a supporting element. Once added, the *codename* can be obtained.
10. Select Source language.

    This setting does not impact the default language in the Kentico project. The source language for the connector itself is language agnostic and any localization languages that are configured for a particular Kentico project can be used as the source language for the connector.

    If using Kontent.ai with multiple source languages, set up multiple instances of the connector with different source languages configured in this field.
11. Click Test connection.

    A checkmark will appear if the connection was successful. A red exclamation point will appear if it wasn't. Hover over the icon to see additional details.
12. Select Kontent.ai workflows.

    By configuring workflows for a Kontent.ai Project, the workflow can be tuned to provide localization when needed. Kontent.ai workflows are configured for each project individually. By setting the Project ID in the connector configuration, only the remote workflow steps for the specified project ID are displayed.

    - Translate articles from:

      The connector monitors articles in the selected stage (e.g. Translate). The author can apply this label to articles when ready for translation.

    **Upon import from Kontent.ai:**

    - Set source articles to

      The connector advances the workflow to the selected stage (e.g. Translation in Progress) when the source articles are downloaded.

    **Upon export to Kontent.ai:**

    - Set source articles to

      The connector sets the workflow stage of the source articles to the selected stage (e.g. Translations Completed) when the translation is exported.
    - Set translated articles to

      The connector sets the workflow step of the article translations to the selected stage (e.g. Translation ready for Review) when the translation is exported.
13. Click Save.

    The connector is added to the list on the Connectors page.

###### Delete a Connector

To delete a connector:

1. From the Integrations page, select the connector to delete.
2. Click Delete.

   The Delete connector window opens.
3. Type "delete" and click Delete.

   The connector is deleted and the list of connectors is displayed.

##### Note

A connector cannot be deleted while it is still linked to incomplete jobs in a project, including jobs sitting in the Recycle bin. Attempting to delete such a connector returns a "Failed to delete connector" error.

Resolution: Open the project associated with the connector and complete or delete any remaining jobs. Go to Settings/Recycle bin, and empty it to remove any jobs still linked to the connector. Retry deleting the connector.

### Marketo (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709654422812-Marketo-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-22T06:10:42Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan (not available for LSP plans)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Marketo is automation software designed for account-based marketing and other marketing services.

Marketo connector allows the downloading of source content and uploading of translations to/from a Marketo server for the following content types:

- Emails
- Email templates
- Files
- Forms
- Landing pages
- Landing page templates
- Segmented dynamic content
- Snippets (including landing pages and emails)

##### Segmentation

Content from all segments is imported into one job for language-neutral segmentation (e.g. gender). Content from each segment is then imported into separate jobs for language-specific segmentation (e.g. preferred language). These translations are stored within the original document as segmented dynamic content.

Mapping between segments and target languages is configured in the connector settings. Multiple segments can share the same target language. Each connector instance supports only one source segment. To deliver translations to multiple target languages while preserving per-segment content, configure a separate connector for each segment.

Target languages configured on the Marketo connector must exactly match the target languages configured in the [project template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687) or [service](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709616197788#UUID-1614da62-87e2-eb83-1fd1-a65b8d4f37d4) that uses the connector to ensure other functionalities, such as Submitter portal, work correctly.

Mapping a segment as a delivery target overwrites that segment's existing content with the translated content of the source segment. To create distinct assets instead of overwriting segment content, select as separate documents under Create translations in connector settings. This option does not preserve segment-specific content.

##### Template Restrictions

Localized templates and assets have the same name as the `original-name [language]` (e.g. Black Friday Promo [de-de]). A localized asset references a localized version of an object (template, snippet, etc.) provided the object exists in that language. If not, it references the original object.

Only approved templates can be referenced. If the template is localized, the connector automatically moves it to the approved state.

##### Excluding Modules from Translation

To exclude Marketo modules from translation, add data-translate attributes to the module's first HTML tag and set the respective variable that controls its visibility either to false, 0, none, or hidden.

Example:

```
<div class="mktoText" id="leftsidebar" mktoname="Left Sidebar">
  <h3 data-translate="${leftSitebar}">This heading will be excluded</h3>
  <p>This paragraph will be excluded too</p>
</div>
```

##### Variables translation and mapping

- Only supported if Create translations -> as separate documents is selected in connector settings.
- Variables mappings are specified in connector settings. In the variable name, set the Marketo variable name without the enclosing ${} and in the value field, set the required value that should be used in translated asset. In the value field, the `{targetLang}` (target asset language), `{targetLangDir}` (target asset language direction: *ltr*, *rtl*) macros can be used.
- All string variables in landing pages that are not mapped in connector settings are translated.
- Variables translation is not supported for emails (only global variables mapping is supported).

#### Configure In-Context Preview

The In-context preview feature offers a real-time preview of original or translated text in both the CAT web editor and CAT desktop editor.

Tables, columns, various graphics, formatting, and fonts (if installed by users) are supported. The feature is meant to provide context when translating and is not a perfect representation of the original or completed document; some visual differences are expected. It can also be influenced by enabling/disabling *Allow loading of external content in editors* option in Access and Security settings.

**Phrase requirements:**

- Pass through the enterprise firewall to access the on-premise installation.
- Authenticate into the authoring environment.

**Firewall configuration for on-premise installation:**

- Installation must be accessible from the Phrase server IP addresses. Refer to [Phrase Servers IP Addresses](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5784099126044-Phrase-Servers-IP-Addresses) for the current list.
- Domain name must be able to be resolved externally.

##### Note

Some HTML tags present a risk and the CAT editor removes them from this HTML when displaying the preview. This is to ensure user's data privacy and security.

Examples of removed tags include `FORM`, `IFRAME`, `SCRIPT`, `SVG`, `VIDEO`, `EMBED`, `OBJECT` or background-image CSS properties.

Marketo dynamic-content-image-segment blocks store text as alt or label text for an image. This text has no visible anchor in the rendered email, so the In-context preview cannot highlight it directly and instead highlights the nearest visible occurrence of matching text.

Marketo dynamic content jobs can merge multiple segment variants (Default, 50-100k, 2-50k, <2k) into a single MXLIFF file. In-context preview renders only the Default variant. Segments belonging to the other variants appear in the grid without a corresponding element in the preview. All segments remain translatable and export correctly.

#### Use Cases

There are a number of use cases for the connector:

- Project managers can add files directly to projects from an online repository.
- Set up the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76) to allow Submitters to add files to requests directly from the online repository.
- Use [automated project creation (APC)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) to have new projects automatically created when a change in the **last modified date** is detected for monitored files or a folder.

#### Marketo Settings

1. Enable REST APIs in the Marketo account.

   See [Marketo documentation](https://developers.marketo.com/rest-api/) for instructions.
2. Go to Admin and click on LaunchPoint in the Integration section.
3. Create a new service or view details of an existing service.
4. Copy and save your Client ID and Client Secret.
5. Close the dialog box and navigate back to the Integration section of the Admin page.
6. Select Web Services.
7. Copy the subdomain from the *Identity* URL in the *REST API* section (e.g. 000-MJB-007).

#### Phrase TMS Settings

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682277316124) page, scroll down to the Integrations section.
2. Click on Connectors.

   The Connectors page opens.
3. Click New connector.

   The Create connector page opens.
4. Change the Type to *Marketo* and provide a name for the connector.
5. Provide the following information:

   - Marketo API key

     Enter Marketo Client ID.
   - Marketo API secret

     Enter Marketo Client Secret.
   - Marketo API identity URL

     Enter the first part of the Marketo Identity URL
   - If requested by Technical Support team, select Log debug information.
   - Create translations options:

     - If not using language-specific segmentation to store target translations, select as separate documents.
     - If using language-specific segmentation, select as segmented dynamic content, and click Test connection.

       Provide Segmentation name and mapping requirements from the dropdown lists and indicate which segment contains the source content.
   - Select Translate tokens to include tokens in translation.
   - Select Translate snippets to include snippets in translation.
   - Optionally, configure Workspaces. This is only needed if the Marketo account has multiple workspaces. Enter the exact workspace name as it appears in Marketo under Admin/Users & Roles/Workspaces. This is case-sensitive and must match exactly. Leave blank to use the account's default workspace.
6. If not verified in the previous step, click Test connection.

   A checkmark will appear if the connection was successful. A red exclamation point will appear if it wasn't. Hover over the icon to see additional details.
7. Click Save.

   The connector is added to the list on the Connectors page.

###### Delete a Connector

To delete a connector:

1. From the Integrations page, select the connector to delete.
2. Click Delete.

   The Delete connector window opens.
3. Type "delete" and click Delete.

   The connector is deleted and the list of connectors is displayed.

##### Note

A connector cannot be deleted while it is still linked to incomplete jobs in a project, including jobs sitting in the Recycle bin. Attempting to delete such a connector returns a "Failed to delete connector" error.

Resolution: Open the project associated with the connector and complete or delete any remaining jobs. Go to Settings/Recycle bin, and empty it to remove any jobs still linked to the connector. Retry deleting the connector.

### Phrase Notion Plugin (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/28041980217372-Phrase-Notion-Plugin-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-30T06:09:45Z  
> Labels: edited_at

The Phrase Notion Plugin is a browser-based integration for submitting Notion pages to Phrase TMS for translation. No connector setup or admin configuration is required. When translation is complete, translated pages are imported back to the Notion workspace as cloned pages in the same database hierarchy.

#### Pre-requisites

Before getting started, ensure the following:

- An active Phrase TMS account.
- A Phrase TMS API token (generate in your Phrase account settings).
- Admin or Member access to the Notion workspace selected for translation.
- Notion pages organized in a database. Standalone pages are not supported.

#### Usage

##### Connect the Plugin

1. Open the plugin at the URL for the relevant data center.

   - EU: notion.eu.phrase.com
   - US: notion.us.phrase.com
2. Enter the Phrase TMS API token. The token is stored securely and does not need to be re-entered unless the browser cache is cleared.
3. Click Connect to Notion and complete the OAuth flow. Select the pages or databases to grant the plugin access to.

##### Note

Pages in private Notion spaces cannot be accessed via OAuth. This is a Notion API limitation. Only standalone pages outside a private container are selectable. For pages in public spaces, expand the page tree on the right side of the Notion authorization screen to make them selectable.

##### Submit Pages for Translation

1. In the Submission panel, select the Notion pages to translate. Pages must be part of a Notion database.
2. Select a project template from your Phrase TMS account.
3. Add the target languages.
4. Click Submit. A new Phrase TMS project is created automatically.

One submission creates one Phrase TMS project. Multiple pages can be submitted within a single project.

##### Monitor Translation Status

1. Open the Monitoring panel to see the status of submitted projects.
2. Click Refresh to retrieve the latest status from Phrase TMS.

Status updates are not automatic. To check progress, refresh manually.

##### Retrieve Translated Pages

1. In the Monitoring panel, find a completed project and click Import.
2. The plugin retrieves the translated content from Phrase TMS and creates cloned pages in the Notion workspace
3. Cloned pages appear in the same hierarchy as the source page.

Importing always creates a new cloned page in Notion. The original source page is not modified.

#### Supported Content Types

The plugin extracts and translates the following Notion block types:

- Paragraph
- Heading 1, Heading 2, Heading 3
- Bulleted list
- Numbered list
- Toggle
- Quote
- Callout

#### Known Limitations

The following content types are **not supported** in the current release:

| Not suported | Note |
| --- | --- |
| Database properties | Text content of database pages is translated; database property values (e.g. tags, select fields) are not extracted. |
| Tables | Table blocks on pages are not extracted. |
| Images | Notion API does not support writing images to translated pages |
| To-do items (checkboxes) | Not extracted. |
| Code blocks | Not extracted. |
| Multi-column layouts | Not supported; columns are not preserved on import. |
| Bookmarks and embeds | Not extracted. |
| Equations | Not extracted. |
| Synced blocks | Not extracted. |
| Child pages | Sub-pages are not followed or submitted automatically. |

**Rich text formatting** (text colors, background colors) is preserved in most cases. If you notice formatting loss, report it via your customer success manager or our support form.

#### Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I translate pages from a private Notion space?**

No. Notion's OAuth flow does not support page-level access for pages in private spaces. Move the page to a public space before submitting.

**Can I retranslate a page if the source content changes?**

Yes. Submit the updated source page again. A new Phrase TMS project will be created. When the project is complete, click **Import** to create a new cloned page in Notion. Previous translated versions are not overwritten.

**What happens to images in my Notion pages?**

Images are not extracted or imported back by the plugin. This is a Notion API limitation: the API does not support writing images to translated pages. Images in the source page will not appear in the translated clone.

**Can I use my own MT or translation memory settings?**

Yes. The plugin creates a standard Phrase TMS project using the template selected at submission. All Phrase TMS features (translation memory, MT engines, AutoAdapt, terminology, and workflows) apply as configured in your account.

**Does the plugin work with Phrase Strings?**

No. The plugin connects to Phrase TMS only.

**The plugin is not showing my pages. What should I do?**

Check that you granted the plugin access to the relevant pages during the Notion OAuth flow. In Notion, go to **Connections** > **Manage connections**, select **Phrase TMS**, then select **Select pages** to manage access. Also confirm that the pages are part of a Notion database as standalone pages are not selectable.

**My pages are in a database but they are not appearing. What should I do?**

Confirm that you selected the database (not individual pages) when granting access during the OAuth flow. If the database is in a public space, expand the tree to find and select it explicitly.

### Phrase Translate for Adobe Express

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/30051691900188-Phrase-Translate-for-Adobe-Express  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-08T06:09:17Z

#### Available for

- All paid plans, with the Adobe Express connector enabled for the organization

Contact your Phrase Customer Success Manager to request access.

Adobe Express is a design and content creation application from Adobe. The Adobe Express connector adds a native Translate button inside Adobe Express, powered by Phrase's [AI Translation Agent](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/20660272640284#UUID-d2f83c62-3868-1bfe-75ae-b32b718706c9). Once connected, translation happens directly in Adobe Express, without opening Phrase.

If [translation memories](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75), [term bases](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503), or [style guides](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/25124298060060#UUID-bf4127ed-c920-47ac-3b5e-e80d6b1044af) are set up for the account in Phrase, the AI Translation Agent applies them automatically during translation.

##### Prerequisites

- The Adobe Express connector enabled for the organization.
- A Phrase account with access to [Phrase Language AI](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709660879516#UUID-b0d64b4f-fa01-f7c3-006a-40e0ee0dedd2).
- A Phrase [Platform API token](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/22675071795996#UUID-e68441bf-1d66-9f6a-a2d8-8431abfd8561).

##### Connect Phrase Translate in Adobe Express

To connect Phrase Translate in Adobe Express, follow these steps:

1. Request access to Phrase Translate for Adobe Express from your Customer Success Manager.
2. Once the integration is enabled for the organization, you will be provided with an Adobe Express add-on link to open the authentication screen.
3. Generate a Phrase Platform API token in Phrase: from the Dashboard, click the account initials (top right), then click Settings/Profile and switch to the Access tokens tab. Then click Generate token and select the Phrase Portal as the service.
4. Open the link and click Connect. Make sure the Translate service is set to *Phrase Translate*.
5. In the Phrase API token field, paste a Phrase Platform API token.
6. Under Region, select the Phrase data center that matches the account (European Union or United States).
7. Click Connect.

Once connected, Phrase Translate is available as a translation service in Adobe Express.

##### Note

Each Adobe Express user connects their own Phrase account. There is no shared or service-level connection.

##### Translate Content in Adobe Express

To translate content in Adobe Express, follow these steps:

1. Select the text elements to translate, or click Select all to translate every text element in the file.
2. Under Translate to, select one or more target languages.
3. Under Apply to, confirm the selected elements.
4. Under Translate service, confirm Phrase Translate is selected.
5. Select whether to add the translation to the current file or to a new document.
6. Click Translate.

   Translation runs in the background. Once translation completes, the translated text replaces the original in the target file.

   Click View original to compare the translation against the source text.

### Salesforce Knowledge (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709627852956-Salesforce-Knowledge-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-23T06:09:56Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan (not available for LSP plans)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Salesforce Knowledge is an online content management system that helps businesses with their marketing, sales, and commerce needs. The connector is for both the Classic and the Lightning versions of Salesforce Knowledge.

The **Source language** of a project must match the **Default** language of Salesforce Knowledge configured in *Knowledge Settings*. *English* in Salesforce is actually *English (United States)* full locale.

The connector imports all updatable fields that have either string or textarea datatypes.

The connector complies with the latest Salesforce security requirements: it supports PKCE, refresh token rotation, 30-day idle-token expiry, and IP allowlisting.

##### Note

As of November 1, 2022, the connector supports [continuous localization](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703661468#UUID-2bd6e968-44df-ca0a-4eec-583c56016cba) workflows. If using these workflows, modifying an existing connector will not enable the functionality and a new connector must be created.

#### Use Cases

There are a number of use cases for the connector:

- Project managers can add files directly to projects from an online repository. Only documents that match the connector's source language or don't have any language set are listed.
- Set up the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76) allowing Submitters to add files to requests directly from the online repository. Only documents that match the connector's source language or don't have any language set are listed.
- Use [automated project creation (APC)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) to have new projects automatically created when a change in the **last modified date** is detected for monitored files or a folder.

#### Article Workflow Recommendations

##### Translating source articles

To allow article authors to manually trigger translations, define or create specific fields in Salesforce Knowledge. These fields will be used by the Phrase connector to trigger and track translation workflows. Use existing fields or create custom ones as needed.

###### Required field mappings

To ensure proper communication between Salesforce Knowledge and Phrase TMS, the following field configurations must be in place:

- Triggering translation requests

  - Purpose:

    Define which articles should be sent for translation.
  - Setup:

    Create or designate a field (e.g., `Workflow_stage__c`) that will hold a specific value (e.g., “Translate”) `- recommended type: picklist`
  - Connector mapping:

    In Phrase TMS, map this field to trigger translation only for articles that have this specified value.
- Tracking translation progress

  - Purpose:

    Automatically update an article’s status during the translation process.
  - Setup:

    Use the same field as above or create a separate one.
  - Connector mapping:

    Configure Phrase TMS to set this field’s value to something like Translation in Progress when translation begins.
- Indicating translation completion

  - Purpose:

    Notify users that translation is complete.
  - Setup:

    Use the same field as above or create a separate one.
  - Connector mapping:

    Set this field’s value to something like Translation Completed once translations are pushed back to Salesforce.
- Defining target languages for automated project creation (APC)

  - Purpose:

    Specify which languages an article should be translated into.
  - Setup:

    - Create a custom field (e.g., `Target_Languages__c`).
    - Field Type:

      Multi-select picklist.
    - Values:

      Use language codes (e.g., `fr, de, es`) as API Names, not labels.
  - Connector mapping:

    Phrase TMS reads this field to create jobs only for the selected languages.

#### Phrase TMS Settings

##### Important

If accessing from a custom domain (ex. `mydomain.phrase.jp`), open an incognito browser window and log in via `cloud.memsource.com` or `us.cloud.memsource.com` to apply the authentication required for the creation or saving of the connector. After saving, the connector can be accessed via the custom domain.

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682291176604) page, scroll down to the Integrations section.
2. Click on Connectors.

   The Connectors page opens.
3. Click New connector.

   The Create connector page opens.
4. Change the Type to *Salesforce Knowledge* and provide a name for the connector.
5. Provide the name of the host.
6. Optionally define when articles are to be translated based on [field value](https://support.phrase.com#UUID-ead2e01d-689d-dfca-f5a4-13542ea6e1ac "Salesforce Knowledge (TMS)").
7. Optionally define a field in the source articles to be changed to a selected value (e.g. translation ready) when the first translation is exported.
8. Optionally define field value on post-translation.
9. Select what status translations should have.
10. Provide Translate to languages specified in (APC).

    [Automated project creation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) only creates jobs for languages specified in the custom field identified by its Field Name (e.g. `Target_Languages__c`).
11. Configure Language mapping to map Salesforce's 2-digit locale codes to TMS's 4-digit locale codes.
12. Click Connect to Salesforce.

    A checkmark will appear if the connection was successful. A red exclamation point will appear if it wasn't. Hover over the icon to see additional details.
13. Click Save.

    The connector is added to the list on the Connectors page.

###### Delete a Connector

To delete a connector:

1. From the Integrations page, select the connector to delete.
2. Click Delete.

   The Delete connector window opens.
3. Type "delete" and click Delete.

   The connector is deleted and the list of connectors is displayed.

##### Note

A connector cannot be deleted while it is still linked to incomplete jobs in a project, including jobs sitting in the Recycle bin. Attempting to delete such a connector returns a "Failed to delete connector" error.

Resolution: Open the project associated with the connector and complete or delete any remaining jobs. Go to Settings/Recycle bin, and empty it to remove any jobs still linked to the connector. Retry deleting the connector.

#### Salesforce Knowledge Troubleshooting

###### Resolving common OAuth errors during reauthentication

To reauthenticate a connector, open the Salesforce Knowledge connector settings in Phrase, open the connector that shows as Unauthorized, and reauthorize Salesforce access.

If reauthentication fails with the error `We can't authorize you because of an OAuth error` and code `OAUTH_APPROVAL_ERROR_GENERIC`, retry the authentication after some time, since this can occur transiently.

If reauthentication fails with an error stating `invalid_client: app must be installed into org`, the Phrase Salesforce Knowledge Connector connected app has not been installed into the Salesforce org. To resolve this, a Salesforce administrator must:

1. In Salesforce Setup, go to App Manager or Connected Apps OAuth Usage and check whether Phrase Salesforce Knowledge Connector appears as installed.
2. If it does not appear, install it via Setup > Installed Packages, or via the app's installation URL.
3. Verify that the connected app's OAuth policy Permitted Users is not set to "Admin approved users are pre-authorized" without the relevant user's profile or permission set assigned, as this also produces the same error.
4. Retry reauthentication from Phrase.

A Salesforce administrator needs sufficient permissions to install the connected app. If a permissions issue occurs during installation, it may need to be escalated within the Salesforce organization.

### Salesforce Service Cloud (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/26042090175900-Salesforce-Service-Cloud-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-30T06:09:47Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, edited_at

[Phrase Language AI](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709660879516#UUID-b0d64b4f-fa01-f7c3-006a-40e0ee0dedd2) (PLAI) can be used as a translation engine in [Salesforce Service Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/eu/service/cloud/) through the Verbis integration. This enables real-time multilingual communication within Salesforce for customer support environments handling conversations in multiple languages.

This integration consumes [Machine Translation Units](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/11530492252444#UUID-3c8ba1b3-290a-5451-ba45-71797af5a755) (MTUs) on capacity-based plans, and credits on credit-based plans.

**Supported Service Cloud workflows**

- [Case Management](https://www.venizum.com/verbis-salesforce-translation/translation-case-management/) (email-based support)
- Live Chat
- [Messaging](https://www.venizum.com/verbis-salesforce-translation/sfdc-messaging/) channels (e.g., WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, website chatbots, if configured in Salesforce)

##### Translation Workflow

When Phrase Language AI is configured as the translation engine in Verbis, incoming customer messages are automatically detected and translated. Agents can compose responses in their native language while outgoing replies are translated into the customer’s language.

Both the original and translated messages remain available in the conversation. The original message remains accessible through a hover or toggle option. When multiple agents participate, each agent can select a preferred language and the conversation is rendered accordingly.

Translations are processed synchronously to support real-time chat communication.

##### Language Detection and Fallback

Language detection is supported for messages containing 10 characters or more. Very short messages may reduce detection accuracy.

Fallback translation handling is centrally managed within the integration, and no additional external translation configuration is required.

### Salesforce Platform (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/11560213364636-Salesforce-Platform-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-21T11:24:05Z  
> Labels: 2BTr

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Enterprise plan (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Salesforce.com provides a suite of products and services for customers to create, manage and run content through a variety of business areas, including Marketing, Sales and Support.

The Salesforce Platform integration via [Verbis](https://www.venizum.com/verbis-salesforce-translation/) offers the ability to connect Phrase TMS.

Verbis is a Salesforce application that allows Salesforce Platform users to pass different content types for localization. A Marketing Cloud (or other Salesforce supported product) user, who is leveraging Verbis, will be able to take an email or website content and send it for localization.

**Salesforce Platform:**

- Salesforce Marketing Cloud
- Salesforce Experience Cloud
- Salesforce Knowledge
- Salesforce Digital Experience

**Supported file formats:**

- [.XLIFF](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709613119516#UUID-e95395fa-bc12-6247-0a1a-9b79950fc242) files from Salesforce

#### Use Cases

There are a number of use cases for the connector:

- TMS Project managers can add files directly to TMS projects from an online repository.
- Use [automated project creation (APC)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) to have new projects automatically created when a change in the **last modified date** is detected for monitored files or a folder.

#### Salesforce & Verbis Settings

To connect the Verbis account to Salesforce Platform, follow these steps:

1. Install Verbis from [Salesforce AppExchange](https://appexchange.salesforce.com/).
2. Go to your Salesforce organization, for example, `https://[yourorg].lightning.force.com`.
3. Click the App Launcher and search for **Verbis**. The app appears in the list if the package is installed correctly.
4. Open the **Verbis** app. The Verbis Admin tab appears in the navigation bar at the top.
5. Ensure that the correct Salesforce Product is connected (as an example, Marketing Cloud).
6. Setup Translation Templates where Source and Target languages will be specified for the localization:

   1. From Translation Templates, click New.
   2. Provide a name for the template.
   3. Select a Source Language.
   4. Add an optional description.
   5. Select a Work Type (as an example, Market Cloud).
7. Multiple templates can be created for different Salesforce products.

#### Phrase TMS Settings

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682260131100) page, scroll down to the Integrations section.
2. Click on Connectors.

   The Connectors page opens.
3. Click New connector.

   The Create connector page opens.
4. Change the Type to Salesforce Suite and provide a name for the connector.
5. Click Connect to Salesforce.

   A checkmark will appear if the connection was successful. A red exclamation point will appear if it wasn't. Hover over the icon to see additional details.
6. Click Save.

   The connector is added to the list on the Connectors page.

###### Delete a Connector

To delete a connector:

1. From the Integrations page, select the connector to delete.
2. Click Delete.

   The Delete connector window opens.
3. Type "delete" and click Delete.

   The connector is deleted and the list of connectors is displayed.

##### Note

A connector cannot be deleted while it is still linked to incomplete jobs in a project, including jobs sitting in the Recycle bin. Attempting to delete such a connector returns a "Failed to delete connector" error.

Resolution: Open the project associated with the connector and complete or delete any remaining jobs. Go to Settings/Recycle bin, and empty it to remove any jobs still linked to the connector. Retry deleting the connector.

#### Using the Integration

To send content for localization within Salesforce, follow these steps:

1. Ensure a localized file is prepared in the appropriate Salesforce Platform for the plan.
2. From Salesforce.com, click Verbis to open the application.
3. From the Translation Projects menu, select New Translation.

   The New Translation Project window opens.
4. Select the Salesforce Platform that is to be translated from.
5. Select an account from the dropdown list.

   The folder list is presented.
6. Select the required Template, Target Language and Due Date.
7. Click Create.

   The file is now ready to be pulled into Phrase.

Importing and Exporting Files into Phrase

- This can be done manually via the [Import Jobs](https://support.phrase.com/document/preview/4557#UUID-86543056-6056-5c1b-8666-45bc5d78c2c8) function or automatically using [Automated Project Creation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553) function.
- Once a file is localized within Phrase, depending on if working manually or through APC, its can be exported back into Salesforce.
