### Sharing (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703948444-Sharing-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-08-17T06:04:11Z  
> Labels: Project Manager, 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Team, Professional, Business, Enterprise plans
- Enterprise trials

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Team, Ultimate and Enterprise plans (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Sharing allows the sharing of resources between different organizations within the same [data center](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5748008399388#UUID-c4ad434d-6658-2e9d-6190-53554ba2bdff) as defined in Phrase. One organization creates a project and then shares that project or selected jobs with another organization. Shared resources can be searched by clicking Search shared space on the Search results page.

Sharing is a connection between two cooperating organizations: a *Buyer* and a *Vendor*. These roles are not fixed to an organization but describe the relationship between them for a specific resource. In some projects, an organization can act as a *Buyer*, while for others it can act as a *Vendor*.

Lifetime of shared projects is controlled by criteria from the buyer's end. Once a shared project is no longer available in the buyer's profile, it also disappears from the vendor's organization.

###### Buyer

A Buyer is an organization with a profile that can assign projects to other organizations (vendors) . To act as a Buyer, the Team/Professional (or higher) plan is required.

###### Vendor

A Vendor is an organization that can be assigned projects or jobs by other organizations (Buyers). All paid plans can function as a vendor.

- Vendors have their own profiles in which they can create and edit projects, translation memories and term bases.
- Vendors can accept shared projects or jobs from translation buyers. They can attach their own translation memories and term bases and use these resources in addition to the resources attached by the project owner.
- Vendors can split files, run their own analyses, assign files within their teams, or even further sub-contract work to other partners.

##### Tip

Filter *by Buyer* and the *Buyer* column are available in both the project list and jobs view. The jobs view also supports grouping jobs *by Buyer*.

#### Setup Vendor Connection

A Buyer needs to establish the Vendor connection before sharing projects or jobs with them. The Vendor organization needs to provide its *Vendor token* to the Buyer in order to set it up.

To set up a Vendor Connection, follow these steps:

1. From the Vendor organization, go to the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682191176220) page, scroll down to the Organization section and copy the Vendor token.
2. From the Buyer organization, from the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682191176220) page, scroll down to the Administration section and click on Vendors.

   The Vendors page opens.
3. Click New.

   The Create page opens.
4. Enter the Vendor token.
5. Apply Net rate scheme, Price list and Relevancy information if applicable.
6. Click Save.

   Vendors page opens with new vendor added to the list.

Projects can now be shared between the Vendor and the Buyer and jobs can be shared with one or multiple Vendors.

In each PM user's settings, vendors can restrict access to only projects and jobs from selected buyers. If no buyers are selected, the PM can access all shared projects and jobs.

##### Note

Deleting a Vendor from the Vendors page does not remove their access to the shared projects or jobs. To restrict access, unassign relevant [shared projects](https://support.phrase.com#UUID-5749c887-b7e0-35b4-0617-8ed9c02e2ecb_UUID-27b3e250-1108-2e11-f65f-80d1d6f713fa "Sharing Projects") or [jobs](https://support.phrase.com#UUID-5749c887-b7e0-35b4-0617-8ed9c02e2ecb_UUID-5cfc62e2-875c-b8fa-c3b2-73efe813613a "Sharing Jobs").

#### Sharing Projects

A shared project enables separate organizations to collaborate using their own resources such as translation memories, term bases, MT engines, and users.

###### Use cases:

- A corporate customer sharing a project with a translation company.
- A multi-language Vendor sharing projects with single-language Vendors.
- A translation company sharing projects with users who have a Team Start profile, instead of only being able to assign them to [Linguist users](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5793349215900#UUID-09f99b48-09c7-b144-42bb-a1bfd2e7d452).

##### Share a Project

To share a project:

- From a Project page, click Share and select Share with vendor or Transfer to Buyer.

  On the Projects page, the shared project is indicated with ![Shared_project.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682143507868).

To stop sharing a project with a Vendor, follow these steps:

1. From a Project page, select the shared project, click Share and select Share with vendor.

   The Share with vendor page opens.
2. Select the first empty line in the Vendor list and click Save.

   The project is no longer shared.

##### Note

The Use vendors option must be enabled in the project's [Access and security](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82) settings to display the Share button.

##### Shared Project Ownership

When a Buyer organization creates a new Vendor, a Buyers list is displayed for the vendor organization under its setup. The connected Buyer organizations are listed and the Vendor can select a default project owner for each Buyer.

Shared projects always have two project owners:

- Buyer project owner
- Vendor project owner

Project ownership can be transferred from Vendor to Buyer if the Vendor creates a project and then shares it ex-post with a Buyer.

##### Shared Project User Visibility

Both the Buyer and the Vendor can see each other's project owner username.

In the CAT editor, all users are fully anonymized. Neither organization can see the other's users.

Linguist names are always hidden between organizations in both Phrase TMS and the CAT editor.

##### Shared Project Rights

A fairly open framework for collaboration that is based on mutual trust between the Buyer and the Vendor is provided.

Few actions are locked in the relationship and unwanted or mistaken actions can be reverted.

###### Buyer rights

- The Buyer has a full right to the project and all Buyer's resources (TM/TB, MT engine, etc.)
- The Buyer may not edit, export, or unselect Vendor's TMs/TBs.
- The Buyer is not able to see the names of Vendor Linguists but can see the job status set by the Vendor's Linguist.
- The Buyer can see and download Vendor's analyses, but is not able to edit them or use them to create quotes.

###### Vendor rights

The Vendor may not:

- Delete a shared project.
- Modify project machine translation settings.
- Save shared project as template.
- Edit, export, or unselect a Buyer's TMs/TBs.
- See the names of Buyer's Linguists.
- Edit Buyer's Analysis or use it to create a quote.
- Edit Buyer's MT engine settings in Phrase Language AI.
- Create or add custom fields to shared projects at the job level.

The Vendor may:

- Create/edit/delete jobs, analyses, and reference files.
- Split/pre-translate/download jobs.
- Add subsequent workflow steps (Vendor workflow steps need to have higher hierarchical order).
- Assign Vendor Linguists to jobs.
- Add Vendor TMs/TBs.
- Share jobs with other Vendors.
- See and download Buyer's analysis.
- See Buyer TBs/TBs settings, including the TM penalty.
- See and use Buyer's MT engines for pre-translation and relevant MT suggestions in the CAT pane.

###### Deletion

- When a Vendor deletes an item in a shared project, both the Buyer and Vendor will be able to undelete it from the [recycle bin](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709704092572#UUID-6b81f2a3-0a67-b670-7244-cab428384874 "Deleted Content (TMS)").
- When a Buyer deletes an item in a shared project, only the Buyer will be able to undelete it.

##### Shared Project Email Notifications

In shared projects, generated email communication is only sent between the two directly connected parties.

1. The Buyer shares the project.

   Vendor1 gets a *Shared project* email.
2. Vendor1 accepts the project.

   The Buyer will then get a *Project status changed* email.
3. Vendor1 assigns/emails a job to Vendor2.

   Vendor2 will get a *New work* email.
4. Vendor2 accepts the job.

   Vendor1 then gets a *Job accepted* email.
5. Vendor2 sets the job to *Completed*.

   Vendor1 will get a *Job completed* email.
6. Vendor1 sets the project to *Completed*.

   The Buyer gets a *Project status changed* email.

##### Shared Project In-app Communication

When shared, involved parties can be [mentioned](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/7681232807708#UUID-0801f553-9b35-4ba4-4a38-46d3fc1e8a34) in [comment](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700374044#UUID-d5b89fba-f861-b990-6511-8db310f9bb86) threads or [LQA](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/27529737766044#UUID-8c8a9e28-99dd-f432-f780-331192127c69) threads in the [CAT editors](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-7174fb87-7107-2f32-ce55-5e040de5446c). In-app [notifications](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709702543260#UUID-42913ba4-f841-e1f0-5b26-084b8fe48c9e "Notifications (TMS)") based on mentions, replies, and LQA finishing are also available.

##### Transferring Project from a Vendor to a Buyer

A Buyer and a Vendor collaboration typically involves a Buyer initiating a project and then sharing it with the Vendor. There are instances when it is the Vendor who initiates the project and then needs to turn it into a shared project ex-post.

An existing project created by a Vendor can be turned into a shared project owned by the Buyer and shared with the Vendor. The Buyer will be notified of the new shared project when it is transferred.

To transfer a project from a Vendor to a Buyer, follow this step:

- From a Project page, select a project, click Share and select Transfer to Buyer.

  The ownership of the project is irreversibly transferred to the Buyer.

#### Sharing Jobs

When multiple Vendors need to be used for a project, the jobs within that project can be shared.

##### Note

To assign jobs to Vendors, the *Use Vendors for projects* option must be enabled on the project level under *Access and security*.

Inactive linguists do not appear as available in shared jobs.

###### Use Cases:

- A corporate customer (Buyer) shares jobs within a project with multiple Vendors where different Vendors are responsible for different target languages.
- A Buyer picks a lead Vendor and shares the project with them. The lead Vendor can then work with multiple sub-Vendors. This would be a combination of a shared project and shared jobs within the same project.
- An MLV (Multi-Language Vendor) assigns jobs to SLVs (Single-Language Vendors). This is typically based on target language specialization.
- A project is shared with one Vendor and jobs in the same project are shared with another Vendor. Sharing the project and its jobs with the same Vendor would not be possible.

##### Share a Job

A [vendor connection](https://support.phrase.com#UUID-5749c887-b7e0-35b4-0617-8ed9c02e2ecb_UUID-b0eac2e1-b02c-15fc-7487-2ea1cd25b267 "Setup Vendor Connection") must be established before being able to share a job.

To share a job and assign it to a Vendor, follow these steps:

1. Select a job from a Project page and click Edit.

   The job editing page opens.
2. Select one or more Provider(s). Hovering over the selected Provider will display type (Linguist or Vendor).
3. Click Save.

   The Project page opens and the provider(s) are associated with the job.

##### Shared Job Rights

Shared jobs are more Buyer-driven. Vendor rights in a shared job are limited in comparison to shared projects.

###### Buyer rights

- The Buyer has full Project Manager rights in a shared job.
- The Buyer is not able to see the names of the Vendor's Linguists but can see the job's status set by the Vendor's Linguist.
- The Buyer can neither see nor access the Vendor's TM and TB (if the Vendor added any to the job), nor see the matches coming from these in the Editors.
- The Buyer cannot see vendor analyses and quotes.

###### Vendor rights

The Vendor may:

- See only the jobs assigned to the Vendor by the Buyer.
- See analyses assigned to the Vendor by the Buyer (that the Buyer created).
- See Buyer's Domain and Subdomain (but not buyer's Client, Cost Center and Business Unit)
- Add their own TM.
- Add their own TB.
- See and use Buyer's MT engines for pre-translation and relevant MT suggestions in the CAT pane.
- Split and join jobs.
- Create analyses.
- Assign shared jobs to the Vendor's Linguists.

  Only active linguists appear when adding Provider to a job.
- Download a local copy of [LQA scorecards](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/27529737766044#UUID-8c8a9e28-99dd-f432-f780-331192127c69) in assigned jobs, or create their own download URL to share with users from the Vendor's organization.
- See Buyer TBs/TBs settings, including the TM penalty.

The Vendor may not:

- See jobs that are not directly assigned to them.
- See Buyer's analyses that are not assigned to them.
- Delete jobs.
- Change the settings of the Buyer's translation memory or term base within the project.
- Edit or export Buyer's TMs/TBs.
- Use LQA scorecard download URLs created by the Buyer.
- Edit Buyer's MT engine settings in Phrase Language AI.
- Populate custom fields with values at the job level.

##### Shared Job User Visibility

The Vendor can see the Buyer's project owner username. The Buyer cannot see the Vendor's project owner username.

In the CAT editor, all users are fully anonymized. Neither organization can see the other's users.

Linguist names are always hidden between organizations in both Phrase TMS and the CAT editor.

##### Shared Job Email Notifications

In shared jobs, all parties receive notification of every *Accepted* or *Completed* job change.

**Example:**

The Buyer shares a job with Vendor1, and Vendor1 then shares that job with Vendor2.

The job has to be not only assigned, it must also be emailed.

1. The Buyer shares a job with Vendor1.

   Vendor1 receives a *New work* email from the Buyer.
2. If Vendor1 accepts the job.

   The Buyer receives a *Job Accepted* email from Vendor1.
3. Vendor1 then shares the job with Vendor2.

   Vendor2 receives a *New Work* email from Vendor1.
4. Vendor2 Accepts the job.

   Vendor1 receives a *Job Accepted* email from Vendor2 and the Buyer receives a *Job Accepted* email from Vendor1.
5. Vendor2 Completes the job.

   Vendor1 receives a *Job Completed* email from Vendor2 and the Buyer gets a *Job Completed* email from Vendor1.

Step 2 can be skipped if Vendor1 shares the job with Vendor2 without accepting it first. If this happens, the Buyer would receive only 1 *Job Accepted* email after Vendor2 accepted it.

##### Shared Job In-app Communication

When shared, involved parties can be [mentioned](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/7681232807708#UUID-0801f553-9b35-4ba4-4a38-46d3fc1e8a34) in [comment](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700374044#UUID-d5b89fba-f861-b990-6511-8db310f9bb86) threads or [LQA](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/27529737766044#UUID-8c8a9e28-99dd-f432-f780-331192127c69) threads in the [CAT editors](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-7174fb87-7107-2f32-ce55-5e040de5446c). In-app [notifications](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709702543260#UUID-42913ba4-f841-e1f0-5b26-084b8fe48c9e "Notifications (TMS)") based on mentions, replies, and LQA finishing are also available.

#### Error Messages

###### "The job has already been claimed by another provider or you don't have the rights to view this page."

This message is shown when a user tries to access a job they do not have access to. The reason for this might be:

- The user / linguist is trying to access a job while being logged to an account of a different organization.
- The job is no longer assigned to the user / linguist, because it was claimed by someone else, or the project manager unassigned the user, or the project manager did not assign the job at all.

### Custom Fields

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060868380-Custom-Fields  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-02T07:14:39Z  
> Labels: Project Manager, 2BTr

#### Available for

- Business and Enterprise plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Custom fields can be added to projects and jobs beyond the standard *[Business Units](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709562165916#UUID-31acda01-ba84-069d-e857-37efba29666c)*, *Client*, *Domain*, etc., fields. These fields can be used to apply customized metadata to projects and jobs to help organize and track projects with data that fits the organization's workflows.

Custom fields are visible and filterable on the project list and represented on the project page. They are visible on the [Jobs page](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825555367452#UUID-b84e994d-143b-9758-ee5c-8ce224df0d66 "Jobs Page (TMS)") when enabled in column settings.

Job custom fields can be updated via API using the [Edit Custom Field](https://cloud.memsource.com/web/docs/api#tag/Custom-Fields/operation/editCustomFieldJob) endpoint.

Custom fields can only be added by [administrators](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709753812124#UUID-c512e8a2-c3ee-7321-9b76-81f0dd72517f) or [PM](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756503196#UUID-f5990e2a-6aa9-ce27-fe52-bdad461726e6)s who have the Modify global server settings option enabled in their user rights.

**Use cases**

- Organize and categorize translation projects flexibly.
- Filter and sort projects/jobs in dashboards and tables.
- Provide additional context to linguists or reviewers.
- Improve reporting and analytics with custom data points.

**Available field types:**

- single select
- multi select
- text
- number
- URL
- date

###### Limitations

- Custom fields are not visible on the classic project list page.
- It is not possible to delete a custom field used in a project.
- It is not possible to delete the value of single-select or multi-select fields used in a project, but they can be deprecated (and later reactivated if required.
- It is not possible to rename the values of single-select or multi-select fields.
- It is not possible to change the field type if the field is already used in a project.
- Custom fields are not saved to TM.
- Custom fields cannot be set up at the [project template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687) level.

###### Sharing

If a buyer adds a custom field to a project or job, it is visible to vendors. Vendors are able to filter projects and jobs by custom fields set by the buyer. Vendors are not able to add their own metadata fields to shared projects or jobs.

#### Create a Custom Field

To create a custom field, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682143603228) page, scroll down to the Project Metadata section and click on Custom fields.

   The Custom fields page opens.
2. Click New.

   The Create new field page opens.
3. Provide a field name and select the desired field type among options available in the Type dropdown.

   - If choosing Select or Multi-select type, add relevant values separated by comma in the Values field. Click **Enter** to apply the values.
4. Optionally, add a description for the newly created custom field.
5. Select where the custom field will be visible.
6. Select whether the custom field is required for new and existing projects by toggling Required field.

   ### Note

   By setting a custom field as required, projects cannot be created or edited without specifying a value for that project metadata.
7. Click Create field.

   The new custom field is added to the list.

Custom fields can be edited from the ![ellipses.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682127227292)menu on the right of the field name. The option to reactive deprecated values is also presented when editing.

#### Assign a Custom Field

To assign a custom field, follow these steps:

1. Custom fields can be created from a project page or when creating a new project or job.

   - From a project page, click Edit.

     The Edit project page opens.
2. Click Add custom fields.

   Available custom fields are listed in a dropdown.
3. Search for the desired custom field and select it.

   Selected custom field is added to project attributes.
4. Assign relevant values for the selected custom field.
5. Optionally, repeat *step 3* and *step 4* to add multiple custom fields to the project.
6. Click Save.

   The selected custom fields are associated with the project.

##### Note

Required custom fields are automatically assigned to new and existing projects and jobs.

### Plural Forms (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709718013980-Plural-Forms-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-02T07:14:41Z  
> Labels: Project Manager, 2BTr, ar_tms

Each language has its own grammatical forms for singular and plural phrases.

Example:

- English has two forms: *one* and *other*, as in *1 file* and *2 file**s***.
- Other languages may have one or even several forms: *one*, *few*, and *other*.

This presents a challenge for localization.

The translation of plural-sensitive strings is supported. These strings must be translated using the plural forms based on the plural rules of the target language. These plural forms must be defined in the source file.

Example:

- The English string *There are %d% items left*, where *%d%* represents any number except 1.
- In Czech, this needs to to be translated in two ways.

  The first for numbers 2, 3 or 4 (i.e. *few*) and the second for numbers 0, 5 and more (i.e. *other*).

[.PO (gettext)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709623142300#UUID-71ae8f89-12f3-4d88-a445-bb4e39fd91fb) files commonly use plural forms as well as [ICU messages](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/7765077293852#UUID-ba78486d-af7b-f9bd-e38a-d039dea68b16).

For more information about plural rules, see [CLDR plural rules](https://cldr.unicode.org/index/cldr-spec/plural-rules).

#### Handling Files with Plural Forms

##### Importing files

When importing files with plural-sensitive strings, the Segment Key should be used as the context type in TM [match context](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386879839900#UUID-3b275425-0cc2-6b63-2971-619cb40d1636) and [optimization](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386873028892#UUID-98135ffb-4d58-e58b-7cda-b173d3e9ea8e). The language locale and the plural category become part of the context of such strings. This is needed for leveraging translation memory matches, avoiding false positives while running QA, and identifying repetitions.

To set the Context type as Segment key, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682160211100) page, scroll down to the Project Settings section and click on TM match context and optimization.

   The TM match context and optimization page opens.
2. For the Context type, select Segment key from the dropdown list.
3. Click Save. The settings are applied to imported files imported.

These settings can also be applied at the project level by editing the project.

##### Leveraging TM matches

If there are multiple TM matches where the match percentage is the same and the source is the same, but where the segment key context is different, the match with the corresponding plural form will be suggested first in the CAT pane and pre-translated based on the preferences.

##### Quality assurance warnings

Plural-sensitive strings can have a different context and this is taken into account when running QA on a job with plural-sensitive strings.

- The warning *Identical source but different translation* is not given if segments with plural-sensitive strings (and a different context) are translated in a different way.
- The warning *Identical translation but different source* is issued when the same translation is used for the same source with a different context.

##### Identifying repetitions

Plural-sensitive strings which have the same source text are not considered repetitions in analyses or in a CAT editor unless they have the same context.

#### Translating Files with Plural Forms

- Once a file with plural-sensitive strings is imported, the plural-sensitive strings are shown in all their forms based on the target language plural rules in separate segments in the editor.
- The required plural form for the active segment is shown in the Context Note at the bottom of the editor, where the *Plural Category* and the *Plural Examples* are specified.
- The Context note is always open when these segments are active to show the required plural details so that the translation is correct.
- Segments containing plural-sensitive strings are indicated by a blue **P** in the info column and the corresponding tooltip.
- Plural-sensitive segments are filtered using the Pluralized filter in the Segment status filter options. They can also be filtered out using the Not pluralized filter.
- Plural-sensitive segments cannot be split or joined.

### Archive (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709748972956-Archive-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-30T06:04:51Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, deleted, File deleted, ar_tms, edited_at

#### Available for

- Team, Professional, Business, Enterprise and Software UI/UX plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Team, Ultimate and Enterprise plans (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

The Archive functionality helps keep the [project](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091188252#UUID-393f1990-2289-4851-99b3-2bdbe8cea0bf "Project Page (TMS)") page relevant. [Archived projects](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/17019781874076#UUID-99ae6922-df28-38ae-ea89-7f7fac88a538) have the same life cycle as non-archived projects.

To archive a project, follow these steps:

1. From the Projects page, select the project to be archived and click Archive.
2. Verify that the project is to be archived.
3. The project is moved to the Archived projects page.

An archived project cannot be viewed in detail, deleted by a user, or have its jobs or analyses accessed, either in the UI or through the API. Only the Restore action is available to a user for an archived project.

To restore a project, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682143739420) page, in the Tools section click on Archived projects.

   The Archived projects page opens.
2. Select the project(s) to be restored.
3. Click Restore.
4. Verify the restoration.
5. The selected project(s) along with all they contain (jobs, analysis, etc.) are returned to the Projects page.

### Translation Memory Threshold Optimizer (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/16057517629852-Translation-Memory-Threshold-Optimizer-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2025-10-10T07:27:53Z

#### Available for

- Team, Professional, Business and Enterprise plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

#### Available for

- Team, Ultimate and Enterprise plans (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

To set up optimal TM thresholds and save editing time, users are offered recommended TM threshold values.

The recommended TM threshold value indicates the TM match at (or above) which it becomes faster to edit the TM pre-translated segments than the MT pre-translated segments (shorter editing time).

The TM threshold set in [pre-translation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717749788#UUID-29b9c1a8-1319-5c47-df68-b0fd50de107c "Pre-translation (TMS)") is the default for [analysis](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)").

[Eingebettetes Video/Inhalt](https://www.youtube.com/embed/fOKPtyPicLM)

##### Note

Due to continuous improvements, the user interface may not be exactly the same as presented in the video.

###### TM threshold visibility

TM threshold value recommendations are provided for organizations meeting the following criteria (jointly):

- Have jobs completed within the previous 6 months.
- Have at least 1000 MT pre-translated segments.
- Have at least one fuzzy score bucket (70-74%, 75-79%, 80-84%, 85-89%, 90-94%, 95-99%) with 300 or more TM pre-translated segments.

For organizations that don’t meet the above criteria, the recommended TM threshold is an average value aggregated from all Phrase TMS anonymized data.

Locations within Phrase TMS that TM thresholds are viewed:

| Where | Customer settings | Recommended TM threshold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Organization settings | Following the default TM threshold | New suggested TM threshold pre-populated in the edit field; users can still modify it and set to a desired value |
| Organization settings | TM threshold configured manually but lower than the recommended value | Existing threshold untouched in the edit field; recommended new threshold suggested in the frame below |
| Organization settings | TM threshold equal or higher than the recommended value | No suggestion displayed |
| Project settings | TM threshold below the recommended value | Existing threshold untouched in the edit field; recommended new threshold suggested in the frame below |
| Project settings | TM threshold equal or higher than the recommended value | No suggestion displayed |

Data used for the calculation of the recommended TM thresholds are viewed in [Phrase Analytics](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/6554447243036#UUID-4971a474-63e7-d58f-1e32-4fc570c69320).

###### TM threshold calculation

An example calculation:

| MT segments | avg editing time (s) |
| --- | --- |
| 4350 | 7.801 |

1. Gather data from previous 6 months.

   | TM fuzzy score bucket | TM segments | avg editing time (s) |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | 0-69% | 2543 | 9.36 |
   | 70-74% | 375 | 9.23 |
   | 75-79% | 376 | 8.96 |
   | 80-84% | 423 | 8.39 |
   | 85-89% | 383 | 8.56 |
   | 90-94% | 155 | 8.55 |
   | 95-99% | 2057 | 7.799 |
   | 100-101% | 9416 | 1.98 |
2. Remove unrecommended fuzzy scores (below 70, over 100).

   | TM fuzzy score bucket | TM segments | avg editing time (s) |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | 70-74% | 375 | 9.23 |
   | 75-79% | 376 | 8.96 |
   | 80-84% | 423 | 8.39 |
   | 85-89% | 383 | 8.56 |
   | 90-94% | 155 | 8.55 |
   | 95-99% | 2057 | 7.799 |
3. Remove data points where there are not enough segments (1000 for MT, 300 for TM).

   | TM fuzzy score bucket | TM segments | avg editing time (s) |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | 70-74% | 375 | 9.23 |
   | 75-79% | 376 | 8.96 |
   | 80-84% | 423 | 8.39 |
   | 85-89% | 383 | 8.56 |
   | 95-99% | 2057 | 7.799 |
4. Remove fuzzy scores that have a lower editing time than MT.

   | TM fuzzy score bucket | TM segments | avg editing time (s) |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | 70-74% | 375 | 9.23 |
   | 75-79% | 376 | 8.96 |
   | 80-84% | 423 | 8.39 |
   | 85-89% | 383 | 8.56 |
5. Select the highest fuzzy score remaining from step 4 (85-89%) and set that as the recommended threshold (87%)

### Projects

#### Projects (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709748435484-Projects-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2025-11-14T08:56:56Z

*Projects* are where the main components of a translation project (jobs, translation memories, and term bases) are held together. Before files can be assigned for translation, they must be assigned to and contained within a project.

The following articles provide more information about specific features for working with projects:

- [Project Page](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091188252#UUID-393f1990-2289-4851-99b3-2bdbe8cea0bf "Project Page (TMS)")
- [Project Metadata](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060790556#UUID-8bc25e65-cc9b-2cdc-4859-0a1932000993 "Project Metadata (TMS)")
- [Create a Project](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825044285340#UUID-4f1d1f73-fcde-4de9-9259-bf054ae4b696 "Create a Project (TMS)")
- [Custom Fields](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060868380#UUID-853c25dc-18d4-534f-b241-5654cd68909a "Custom Fields")
- [Project Settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091328028#UUID-d7b8121c-4488-b077-5493-6ca7d30d48d5 "Project Settings (TMS)")
- [XML Profiles](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/11560308549404#UUID-b02925b1-5957-1ff1-532e-95e1a9b25a16 "XML Profiles (TMS)")
- [Search Across Projects](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825044358172#UUID-e4568626-1342-c205-db9e-ca1a6ff5a1f7 "Search Across Projects (TMS)")

#### Project Page (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091188252-Project-Page-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-07-22T06:03:31Z  
> Labels: Project Manager, 2BTr

Opening a project presents it in a project page. A project can be saved as a [template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687) or cloned from the Save as menu. Project details are presented along with any assigned [project metadata](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060790556#UUID-8bc25e65-cc9b-2cdc-4859-0a1932000993 "Project Metadata (TMS)").

The project page features a dashboard followed by tables of associated project attributes:

###### Project dashboard

##### Available for

- Business and Enterprise plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

The Dashboard provides statistics for a specific project and is divided into two sections:

- **Overall progress**

  The overview of job statuses and issues across all workflow steps
- **Individual progress**

  The overview of job statuses and issues in individual workflow steps and language combinations.

If a warning is present in the project, a box appears in the respective section of individual progress. Click on the box to receive a breakdown of the issues.

The Dashboard is available only to Administrators and Project Managers.

###### Jobs table

The jobs table lists all jobs associated with a project and [tools](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557848220#UUID-438e305c-62e8-70af-9565-8895e16fd94f "Job Tools (TMS)") for working with jobs. From the jobs table, jobs can be added, edited (assign providers, set due date, change job status), downloaded (original, complete or incomplete translations, [bilingual](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688974620#UUID-adb08905-9ca5-55e5-3739-95bd935275ea) or [final files](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-52eea4c5-7d94-1750-40ca-86e757b17916 "Workflow (TMS)")), [analyzed](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)"), [pre-translated](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717749788#UUID-29b9c1a8-1319-5c47-df68-b0fd50de107c "Pre-translation (TMS)"), and deleted along with other tools. Multiple files can be selected from the table to be edited at once, but will only open together in the editor if the jobs target language are the same.

Hovering over underlined indicators and icons in the table provides more information about the job such as progress, additions, and word counts. For example, hover the mouse over a job status to see additional information about when the job entered a particular status, such as Accepted and Completed. This can be useful for calculating how long a Linguist has been translating the assigned job(s).

The table can be filtered and the columns can be customized.

If a workflow step is specified in this table, only information about that step is presented in other tables. Linguist users can only view the workflow step where they have an assigned job.

###### Analyses

[Analysis overview](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)")

###### Quotes

[Costs & Quotes](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709635877020#UUID-317de099-f8f9-9c94-dde1-36018cb96947)

###### Translation memories

[Assign a translation memory to a project](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386902997148#UUID-bb70bf2c-cd31-7633-ad2e-1203e0f7436d)

###### Term bases

[Term bases](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503)

###### References

Any type of file can be added as a reference with a 1 GB size limit or just type a note in the text field. HTML tags can be used to add formatting to notes. Multiple reference files can be uploaded at once.

If a project contains references, Linguist will receive a notification when they open the editor. Reference files themselves are available at the bottom section of the Project page. References can be filtered and sorted.

#### Project Metadata (TMS)

Providing metadata to a project helps with management of projects by assigning them business values (client, domain, subdomain, cost center, business unit, note, purchase order#). Access to particular metadata is based on roles and permissions; administrators have access to all metadata, projects managers and others are dependent on access they have been given.

To create values for metadata, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682112139420) page, scroll down to the Project metadata section and select a metadata type.

   The page for the metadata type opens.
2. Click Add *metadata type*.

   The Create page opens.
3. Add a value and click Save.

   The value is added to the metadata type and is available for selection when creating a project. A UID reference with a button to copy it to the clipboard is provided.

#### Create a Project (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825044285340-Create-a-Project-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-02T07:14:45Z  
> Labels: Project Manager, 2BTr

To create a project, follow these steps:

1. From the Projects page, click New project or click the plus ![Add New Template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682143901724) icon beside Projects in the left-hand navigation panel.

   The Create page opens.
2. Provide a name, required languages and a due date.

   If an incorrect source language has been selected when creating a project, it will not be possible to change it. A new project will need to be created with the correct parameters.

   - If a [project template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687) has been created, select the template and these fields will be populated with information from the template.
   - Target languages can be removed only before importing jobs, TMs or TBs that are associated with that language, including jobs in the [recycle bin](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709704092572#UUID-6b81f2a3-0a67-b670-7244-cab428384874 "Deleted Content (TMS)").
   - When creating a project without a template, settings (such as the default file import settings) will be based on the [Project settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091328028#UUID-d7b8121c-4488-b077-5493-6ca7d30d48d5 "Project Settings (TMS)") section of the Settings page.

     ### Note

     Subsequent changes in a project template or the main Settings page will not affect the settings of existing projects.
3. Provide any required [project metadata](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060790556#UUID-8bc25e65-cc9b-2cdc-4859-0a1932000993 "Project Metadata (TMS)") (client, domain, subdomain, cost center, business unit, note, purchase order#) or optionally a [custom metadata field](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060868380#UUID-853c25dc-18d4-534f-b241-5654cd68909a "Custom Fields").
4. Click through the settings pages and apply any requirements.

   - When creating or editing a project, the option to Set unassigned job to completed once previous workflow step is completed is available. If a job is split, all parts of that job must be completed in order to automatically complete following unassigned steps.
5. Click Create project.

   The page for the new project is opened.

Click Edit to open the Edit project page and make changes.

#### Project Settings (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091328028-Project-Settings-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-07-21T06:03:37Z  
> Labels: Project Manager, 2BTr

To access default project settings, click on Settings ![Settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682176554908) in the left hand menu and scroll down to Project settings. Default project settings are applied only to newly created projects. To update settings for an existing project or a [project template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687), edit the specific project or project template.

###### [Access and security](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82)

Features that can help control what parts of a job can be accessed and by whom.

###### [Analysis](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)")

Set the default options for the default and post-editing analysis for your project.

###### [CAT editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-7174fb87-7107-2f32-ce55-5e040de5446c)

- Non-Translatables
- Machine translation

  - If Suggest MT only for segments with a TM match below {set value} is selected:

    - MT suggestions are offered in the CAT editor only if there is no TM match at or above the set threshold.
    - Autocomplete does not trigger MT calls.
    - The resource status indicator notifies linguists that MT is not available.
- [Repetitions](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709708706460#UUID-b94ef2c1-e8fa-b9ce-e18e-242b5873bd1b)

###### [Completed file name and export path](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709608269980#UUID-5c2319f4-9456-388a-cbb3-5ed0b917a6ae)

Set rules for renaming downloaded files for all jobs, and specify the export path for jobs imported from an online repository.

###### [Custom file types](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709649238556#UUID-7ceaabc0-41c4-abce-8153-c59cd2aef737)

Custom file types based on [.XML](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709623320348#UUID-2dc3473c-ad75-e6d1-6d94-f27d2944443c), [.TXT](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709623261340#UUID-fd9b6c29-c806-f7ae-10f6-6609e3d63ad8), [.HTML](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709623015452#UUID-9866b1ec-03c6-aa3e-1035-2930612ec861) or [.JSON](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709604147100#UUID-839bf492-c753-2f54-2062-abb1d360aa14) that are defined by filename and extension can be automatically detected and imported. Once defined, the definition can be used to import that file type in batches when creating a [job](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420#UUID-33f88350-daa8-2ab2-e7ce-e35300ec60f8).

###### [File import settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/5709618056604-File-Import-Settings)

Configure how files are processed when they are imported to create jobs in a project.

For existing projects, the default File import settings are not editable through the UI. They can be viewed and edited when [creating a job](https://support.phrase.com/document/preview/4557#UUID-86543056-6056-5c1b-8666-45bc5d78c2c8) (in the UI) or [modified via API](https://cloud.memsource.com/web/docs/api#operation/editImportSettingsOfProject).

###### [Pre-translation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717749788#UUID-29b9c1a8-1319-5c47-df68-b0fd50de107c "Pre-translation (TMS)")

Set the default pre-translation options for your project.

###### [Project status automation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687)

Project status automation rules enable users to configure when a project‘s status should be automatically changed. Project status automation rules can be saved in a project template and used together with a [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76) or with [automated project creation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647363356#UUID-3fb1230d-d6b0-83ce-cb52-98b96688b553).

###### [Segmentation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709678012828#UUID-753af50b-27d0-e386-418a-452ed30e0083)

Set the default segmentation rule for projects, export, and create custom segmentation rules.

###### TM [match](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386879839900#UUID-3b275425-0cc2-6b63-2971-619cb40d1636) context and [optimization](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386873028892#UUID-98135ffb-4d58-e58b-7cda-b173d3e9ea8e)

Define how context is stored and retrieved from translation memories.

###### [Workflow](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-52eea4c5-7d94-1750-40ca-86e757b17916 "Workflow (TMS)") steps

Create custom workflow steps and enable [Language Quality Assessment (LQA)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709599557020#UUID-071f9a72-20ef-1bcd-9169-14a46ebe0449) for individual workflow steps.

###### [XML profiles](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/11560308549404-XML-Profiles)

#### XML Profiles (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/11560308549404-XML-Profiles-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-02T07:14:47Z  
> Labels: 2BTr

A visual builder is provided for creating and saving custom XML import settings. The builder doesn't connect to connectors so all files need to be uploaded from a local drive to build the profile. If an .XML from a 3rd party connector is exported and uploaded to create an XML profile, it may be used for creating jobs.

[Eingebettetes Video/Inhalt](https://www.youtube.com/embed/H2aV2aZnFZ4)

###### Note

Due to continuous improvements, the user interface may not be exactly the same as presented in the video.

##### Create an XML Profile

Multiple files (10) can be uploaded at a time. When saving a profile where multiple files were used, specify which file to save together with the profile.

To create an XML profile, follow these steps:

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682112376220) page, scroll down to the Project settings section and click on XML profiles.

   The XML profiles page opens.
2. Click New profile.

   The New page opens.
3. Click Upload and provide [.XML](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709623320348#UUID-2dc3473c-ad75-e6d1-6d94-f27d2944443c), .DTD or .XSD files from a local drive.

   The .XML file is rendered in and presented in the Tree view tab. From his view, the file can be searched and filtered ![Filter](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682160550300).

   - Selecting the [XPath](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709652579868#UUID-7ddfc6a3-f37b-e0f1-60d1-14e4fbd40b21) tab will present the same .XML file and if experienced with Xpath, settings can be applied. Settings applied in the Xpath tab will not be presentable in the Tree view tab.
4. Check which parts of the .XML file are required for import.
5. If additional import settings are required, click the settings button ![Edit Filter Settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682127672476) to open the Import settings.

   Import settings can be hidden if not required or already applied by clicking the Hide button.

   - Context key

     Specify a context key that is saved with the segment to the [translation memory](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75) and used for match context.
   - Context note

     Import elements or context attributes for each element.
   - Max. target length

     Import elements or the maximum target length for each element
   - Preserve whitespaces
   - Parse ICU messages

     ICU messages are automatically converted to tags. When a segment contains inline elements, ICU parsing for that segment is skipped. Segments without inline elements are parsed normally.
   - Import XML entities

     XML entities in [DTD Declaration](https://www.w3schools.com/xml/xml_dtd.asp) will be imported for translation.
   - Segment XML

     Deselect if segmentation is not desired.
   - Import comments

     Comments are not imported if elements are processed as HTML as indicated in the *Elements (processed as HTML)* option.
   - Convert to Phrase TMS tags

     Apply [regular expressions](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709636670364#UUID-fecec79b-8d0e-daaa-3327-8435094210ec) to convert specified text to tags.
   - Convert to character entities

     Enter a list of character references (separated by commas) into the output file.

     Example:

     If quotation marks (*"*) are required, they would be represented as `&quot;`, the character Σ would be represented as `&#x3A3;` use `&quot;,&#x3A3;` . *&* and *<* are always exported as `&amp;` and `&lt;` respectively.
6. Apply any required import settings and click Save.

   The Save a copy window opens.
7. Provide a Profile name and an optional Description and click Save.

   The window closes and the profile is added to the XML profiles page.

#### Search Across Projects (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825044358172-Search-Across-Projects-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-02T07:14:48Z  
> Labels: Project Manager, 2BTr

##### Available for

- Business and Enterprise plans

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

##### Available for

- Ultimate and Enterprise plans (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Source and target [segments](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709678012828#UUID-753af50b-27d0-e386-418a-452ed30e0083) text within all or selected non-archived projects is searchable by clicking on Search across projects at the top of the project list. The search across projects functionality is enabled only for [Project managers](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756503196#UUID-f5990e2a-6aa9-ce27-fe52-bdad461726e6) and [Administrators](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709753812124#UUID-c512e8a2-c3ee-7321-9b76-81f0dd72517f).

In the Content search page, use the Find segments section to search for plain text or [regex](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709636670364#UUID-fecec79b-8d0e-daaa-3327-8435094210ec) in the selected projects. [Wildcard search](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733449372#UUID-2a4c8798-761f-051a-255c-f1faf84196e6) is also supported except for quotes `" "`, which enables finding empty segments. Select the `IS` operator from the dropdown to look for content that exactly matches whole segments.

To refine the search by selecting additional criteria, expand the With these attributes section at the bottom. If using advanced search options, the available fields are not filtered according to other filters already applied as search criteria; multiple filters can be combined.

Searches can only be performed within segments with states of Completed, or Canceled and in the last workflow step of a project.

Searching continues asynchronously. It is possible to leave the Search across projects page and return to check search progress or results. The search session will be maintained for 30 days.

Target text found in segments is editable: double click the text or use the pencil icon ![pencil.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682160622108) to edit the segment.

###### Important

- Results are shown from the date when they were first searched so if changes are made, the results may not be from the current state of the segments.
- There is a maximum of 500,000 job parts that a search can be run on. A single job in a project with five worklow steps would be separated into five job parts.
- If a search session is ongoing, the page will initially present that session. Click New search to to start a new search with new criteria.

##### Find and Replace

Find and replace across multiple projects enables users to efficiently update terminology and implement feedback at scale. Instead of modifying search results manually, users can now apply bulk replacements in either the source or target text across multiple projects.

This feature enhances the existing search functionality while maintaining the same support for filters, wildcards, and regex search. Before finalizing changes, a preview is provided where replacements can be accepted or dismissed individually or in bulk.

To use the replace functionality, activate the and replace slider ![replace_function.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682112521756) .

Activating the functionality provides fields for selecting which segment group the selected text should be replaced and what text should be used to replace it.

To find a specific text and replace it, follow these steps:

1. From the Search across projects page, activate the replace function.
2. Select the project or projects to be searched from the dropdown list.
3. Provide specific Source languages or Target languages from the dropdown lists if required.
4. Provide search text and search parameters.
5. Select which segment group text is to be replaced in and provide the replacement text.
6. Apply attribute filters if required.
7. Click Review.

   Each found example of the search text is displayed along with the suggested replacement text.
8. The change can be dismissed, edited or accepted ![Dismiss, edit or accept](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682176831388)in each example or accepted in bulk ![accep_all_changes.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682191840156) .

### Jobs

Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/10825470833436-Jobs

#### Jobs (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420-Jobs-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-15T13:23:30Z  
> Labels: Linguist, Project Manager, 2BTr, ar_tms

A job represents a file for translation into a specified target language(s).

If a single file is to be translated from a source into two target languages, it is represented by two jobs:

- **Job 1**

  Translation of the file into English.
- **Job 2**

  Translation of the file into Italian.

Jobs are presented in the Jobs table on a [Project page](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825091188252#UUID-393f1990-2289-4851-99b3-2bdbe8cea0bf "Project Page (TMS)") where project managers can monitor and work with them.

Users with required permissions can import, edit, manage and export files associated with translation jobs through different [tools and options](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-a6d2ff65-0f54-10ab-be2f-2821d32d3c9e "Jobs Table (TMS)") available in the Jobs table.

###### Note

Changing the name of a job is not possible.

The following articles provide more information about specific features for working with jobs:

- [Create a Job](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825587738268#UUID-5613f0f5-c518-0d1c-810f-e7a4612abf2f "Create a Job (TMS)")
- [Edit a Job(s)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557726492#UUID-2f090210-2360-5350-56b7-900594c1aa1c "Edit a Job(s) (TMS)")
- [Jobs Page](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825555367452#UUID-b84e994d-143b-9758-ee5c-8ce224df0d66 "Jobs Page (TMS)")
- [Jobs Table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-a6d2ff65-0f54-10ab-be2f-2821d32d3c9e "Jobs Table (TMS)")
- [Job Status](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557816092#UUID-e517b5b6-f7f5-9c64-1fde-d981f5d24c41 "Job Status (TMS)")
- [Job Tools](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557848220#UUID-438e305c-62e8-70af-9565-8895e16fd94f "Job Tools (TMS)")

#### Create a Job (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825587738268-Create-a-Job-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-02T07:14:50Z  
> Labels: Linguist, Project Manager, 2BTr

To create a new job, click on the name of a project on the Projects page to open it and follow these steps:

##### Job details

1. From a Project page, in the Jobs table, click New.

   The Create new job page opens.
2. Click Upload file, drag and drop a file on the field or Import from integration if available.

   The uploaded file is presented at the top of the field and can be deleted if required ![trashbin_createjob.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682127907868) .

   Source language is set at the project level.
3. Select target languages (based on [project](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825044285340#UUID-4f1d1f73-fcde-4de9-9259-bf054ae4b696 "Create a Project (TMS)") definition).
4. If [custom fields](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060868380#UUID-853c25dc-18d4-534f-b241-5654cd68909a "Custom Fields") have been set as required by an administrator, select or provide those fields.
5. If permissions have been given to add custom metadata fields, these can be added by clicking the Add custom field dropdown list under Additional details and selecting what is required.
6. Click Create.

   Job(s) are created and added to the list of jobs on the project page.

##### Workflow

1. Select a [pre-translation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717749788#UUID-29b9c1a8-1319-5c47-df68-b0fd50de107c "Pre-translation (TMS)") option.
2. Click in the empty Select provider field to add a provider(s) from the dropdown list if required.

   - Jobs can be assigned to multiple [providers](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703948444#UUID-5749c887-b7e0-35b4-0617-8ed9c02e2ecb "Sharing (TMS)")—either Linguists or Vendors—when creating a new job, editing a job, or when using [project templates](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687).
   - Jobs can be accepted only by one [Linguist](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709735838492#UUID-911ee8d4-ecc1-0c38-8f71-7c22f1646545) at a time.
3. Provide Due date (if applicable).
4. Select Notify providers to automatically send email notifications to providers specified in step 4. Choose an [email template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709617392540#UUID-9344883c-3d65-7641-8b0e-6dfb0aeb17b1) from the dropdown list, and set an interval for sending the notifications (if applicable).

   - In projects with [workflows](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-52eea4c5-7d94-1750-40ca-86e757b17916 "Workflow (TMS)"), notifications are configured separately for each workflow step.
   - If Notify providers is not selected during job creation, use the Email... option in the job's [Tools](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557848220#UUID-438e305c-62e8-70af-9565-8895e16fd94f "Job Tools (TMS)") menu to send a notification later.

   **Example:**

   Three providers have been selected for Czech target language and an interval has been set for 10 minutes. When the selected workflow step starts:

   - Email notification is sent to *Provider 1* immediately.
   - Email notification is sent to *Provider 2* in 10 minutes.
   - Email notification is sent to *Provider 3* in 20 minutes (10 minutes after last notification sent).

In projects with workflow steps, the steps are presented in the Create new job page. The Target languages are pre-populated from first workflow step settings, but each step can have individual Provider, Due and Notify providers settings.

##### File import settings

- Provide [File import settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709621471516#UUID-f8f148d5-8914-1eb9-f214-b029d41dbe85) if required.

  - If source file is in a multilingual format ([.XLSX](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709604373532#UUID-a68697a1-3ac9-5b8d-6497-961d901e4c2e), [.CSV](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709618160028#UUID-849cafcf-74af-f6a8-93ee-0120a97c809a) or [.XML](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709623320348#UUID-2dc3473c-ad75-e6d1-6d94-f27d2944443c)), ensure the correct file type is selected and specify how file content is to be imported and presented in the editor.

    **Example:**

    ![Spreadsheet job options](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682127946524)

    Set segment status of non-empty target allows users to define the status of any segment that already contains the target translation.

    Context key and Context note provide additional information for the translation and can be displayed in the editor.

    Maximum length specifies the maximum number of characters that can be contained in the target translation; characters above the limit are highlighted in the segment.

    Convert to Phrase tags allows application of [regular expressions](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709636670364#UUID-fecec79b-8d0e-daaa-3327-8435094210ec) to convert specified text to tags.
  - If importing an XLIFF file containing HTML code, import the file as Wordpress XLIFF.
  - If under [Character set](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Character_encoding#Common_character_encodings) the Input encoding is not specified, Phrase tries to determine the encoding from the file header. If this is not possible, default encoding is used.

    - For most cases (not for binary formats): UTF-8
    - Java properties: ISO-8859-1
    - SRT: windows-1252
    - Joomla INI: Must be in UTF-8 (It is not possible to change it with Input and/or Output encoding settings.)

    If the file is imported with corrupted characters, check the actual encoding of the file and set the Input encoding accordingly.

##### Advanced settings

- Segmentation

  Set [segmentation rules](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712126876#UUID-caf36da8-4696-7cdf-93dc-3b0ad3703925 "Segmentation Rules (TMS)") for the job.
- Translation memory matches

  [Optimize](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386873028892#UUID-98135ffb-4d58-e58b-7cda-b173d3e9ea8e) how matching is managed for the job.
- Rich HTML/SVG preview

  Provide files for the [in-context](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709664002076#UUID-ac361633-18bb-a420-d5c2-4e11bc726b7f) preview of the original translatable document in one of the following formats:

  - .HTML file
  - .ZIP package containing a main .HTML file plus any additional .HTML or resource files (such as CSS, images)
  - .SVG file

  File size limits: up to 100 MB per .ZIP file and 1 GB for the entire batch of files during bulk import.

**Common Errors:**

- **INVALID\_REQUEST: The input file cannot be processed.**

  A general error informing that there was a temporary problem while importing the file; try importing again after a minute.
- **INVALID\_REQUEST: Cannot process document which has cells merged across rows! See row # - The file may not be of the selected type (BILING\_XLS).**

  This error is displayed if importing a Multilingual XLSX file with merged cells in any of the columns designated for translation.
- If text from import is not displayed, ensure the [character set](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Character_encoding#Common_character_encodings) is correct.

#### Edit a Job(s) (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557726492-Edit-a-Job-s-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2025-11-14T08:54:57Z  
> Labels: Linguist, Project Manager, 2BTr

A single job can be edited, or multiple jobs. Editing jobs allows users to:

- Change the job’s status
- Assign, change, or remove a provider (either [Linguists](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709735838492#UUID-911ee8d4-ecc1-0c38-8f71-7c22f1646545) or [Vendors](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703948444#UUID-5749c887-b7e0-35b4-0617-8ed9c02e2ecb "Sharing (TMS)"))
- Add, change, or remove a due date

###### Note

Editing more than 290 jobs at once will trigger a web error.

To edit a single job, follow these steps:

1. Select a job.
2. Click Edit.

   The Edit 1 job window opens.
3. Select one or more Providers from the dropdown list if required or remove the field.
4. Select a Status from the dropdown list if required or remove the field.
5. Select a Due date if required or remove the field.
6. [Custom fields](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060868380#UUID-853c25dc-18d4-534f-b241-5654cd68909a "Custom Fields") can be applied under Additional details.

   Click Find fields to list fields already applied to the project.
7. Click Next to review applied changes.
8. Click Save and edit.

   Defined parameters are added to the job and presented in the Job list.

To edit multiple jobs, follow these steps:

1. Select jobs.
2. Click Edit.

   The Batch edit X jobs window opens.
3. Select one or more Providers from the dropdown list if required or remove the field.
4. Select a Status from the dropdown list if required or remove the field.
5. Select a Due date if required or remove the field.
6. [Custom fields](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060868380#UUID-853c25dc-18d4-534f-b241-5654cd68909a "Custom Fields") can be applied under Additional details.

   Click Find fields to list fields already applied to the project.
7. Click Next to review applied changes.
8. Click Save and edit.

   Defined parameters are added to the job(s) and presented in the Job list.

###### Note

Edited values in the Providers, Due date and Status fields will be overwritten for all selected jobs. Remove the field to prevent overwriting.

#### Jobs Page (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825555367452-Jobs-Page-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-24T06:05:12Z  
> Labels: Linguist, Project Manager, 2BTr

All jobs can be viewed by project managers on the jobs page. Access to the job pages is from the left-hand menu ![work-grey.svg](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682160883228). The [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-a6d2ff65-0f54-10ab-be2f-2821d32d3c9e "Jobs Table (TMS)") presents jobs associated with a specific project and tools for working with them.

The jobs view allows a PM to group or filter jobs with any applicable metadata and structure views as required. Multiple views can be created and saved by clicking on the name of the view.

Additional columns can be added to the view from the upper right hand drop down menu ![Open Menu](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682177106588).

Selecting multiple jobs allows PMs to apply changes to those jobs from the options presented on the top right of the table:

- Assign providers

  Only available if the job status is New, Emailed or Cancelled.
- Change due date

  Not available if the job status is Accepted or Cancelled.
- Change status
- Notify providers

  To send a new job email, follow these steps:

  1. From the Jobs page, select the jobs to include. The jobs must have providers assigned to email them. Only jobs with assigned providers can be emailed.
  2. Click the three dots and select Notify providers.
  3. Select a notification template from the dropdown.

     ### Note

     Extra text can only be added when the email is sent from the project page, not from the Jobs view.
  4. Click Notify providers.
- Delete

  Deleting a job removes it from all workflow steps. It is not possible to delete a job in only a single workflow step.

###### Note

When changes are applied, a green success toast message confirms that the update is complete, even if the jobs view takes some time to reflect the latest changes.

![success_message_jobs_view.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682160944156)

The ellipsis menu ![ellipses.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682144583068) to the right of any specific job presents options for that job:

- Open in editor
- Notify providers
- Download original
- Download completed
- Delete

#### Jobs Table (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172-Jobs-Table-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-24T06:05:13Z  
> Labels: Linguist, Project Manager, 2BTr

The jobs table lists all jobs associated with a project and [tools](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557848220#UUID-438e305c-62e8-70af-9565-8895e16fd94f "Job Tools (TMS)") for working with jobs. From the jobs table, jobs can be added, edited (assign providers, set due date, change job status), downloaded (original, complete or incomplete translations, [bilingual](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688974620#UUID-adb08905-9ca5-55e5-3739-95bd935275ea) or [final files](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-52eea4c5-7d94-1750-40ca-86e757b17916 "Workflow (TMS)")), [analyzed](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)"), [pre-translated](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717749788#UUID-29b9c1a8-1319-5c47-df68-b0fd50de107c "Pre-translation (TMS)"), and deleted along with other tools. Multiple files can be selected from the table to be edited at once, but will only open together in the editor if the jobs target language are the same.

###### Note

If the target segment is empty when attempting to download a job, the corresponding part of the translated file will be empty as well.

Attempting to download a completed file with empty segments due to missing tags (commonly [.XLSX](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709604373532#UUID-a68697a1-3ac9-5b8d-6497-961d901e4c2e) files) will likely cause an error.

The [jobs page](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825555367452#UUID-b84e994d-143b-9758-ee5c-8ce224df0d66 "Jobs Page (TMS)") presents all jobs for project managers.

If multiple files are selected from the table to be [edited at once](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709695273372#UUID-5dca8a67-ad76-da5a-d4bb-c75751eeac9e), they will open together in the editor (opening more than 100 at a time may cause performance issues).

Hovering over underlined indicators and icons in the table provides more information about the job such as progress, additions, and word counts. For example, hover the mouse over a job status to see additional information about when the job entered a particular status, such as Accepted and Completed. This can be useful for calculating how long a Linguist has been translating the assigned job(s).

The number displayed in the Job number ![Job Number](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682144688540) column is a default value assigned by the system when jobs are created within a project. Users cannot edit the job number or name.

Warnings are labelled with ![yellow_warning.jpg](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682112983324). This indicates the file was uploaded but there are [embedded objects](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709652493340#UUID-55c38a88-3f31-7677-8b0c-a339ed8b9fe9) [embedded objects](https://help.memsource.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003461511-Embedded-objects-warning) or [fields](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709633922460#UUID-cc5c5fdf-111d-d942-5074-f178b6696729) in the document that may have not been imported correctly.

The table can be filtered and the columns can be customized.

###### Note

Although jobs can be downloaded in [.TMX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Translation_Memory_eXchange) format, they cannot be uploaded again in the same format as they do not contain bilingual tables. .TMX files are predominantly used for [translation memories](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75)

Deleting a job removes it from all workflow steps. It is not possible to delete a job in only a single workflow step.

#### Job Status (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557816092-Job-Status-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-24T06:05:14Z  
> Labels: Linguist, Project Manager, 2BTr

Job workflow is represented by the status of a job as indicated in the [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-a6d2ff65-0f54-10ab-be2f-2821d32d3c9e "Jobs Table (TMS)"). The status changes as the job moves through the workflow as [Linguists](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709735838492#UUID-911ee8d4-ecc1-0c38-8f71-7c22f1646545) and Vendors accept, decline, reject or complete jobs or are manually changed by [Project manager](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756503196#UUID-f5990e2a-6aa9-ce27-fe52-bdad461726e6)(s) (s) [editing](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557726492#UUID-2f090210-2360-5350-56b7-900594c1aa1c "Edit a Job(s) (TMS)") the job.

**Basic Workflow:**

![Job Workflow](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682177352988)

There are three additional status that can be applied to a job that change the basic workflow:

- **Declined by Provider**

  Provider does not accept the job. The job is removed from the workflow and the [linguist portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709735838492#UUID-911ee8d4-ecc1-0c38-8f71-7c22f1646545).

  A job can also be declined after acceptance, in addition to being rejected.
- **Rejected by Provider**

  If this option is made available to the provider by a project manager, a job can be rejected after acceptance and is returned to the previous workflow step. The job remains in view but in read-only mode.

  *Example:*

  If [additional steps](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-52eea4c5-7d94-1750-40ca-86e757b17916 "Workflow (TMS)") have been defined in the workflow, a job may be sent to a secondary linguist for a final review. If the job is not considered complete for the final review, the secondary linguist rejects the job sending it back to the initial linguist.
- **Cancelled**

  Only a project manager can cancel a job and they can be cancelled at any point in the workflow. The job is removed from view in the linguist portal.

  Cancelling a job in a project with multiple workflow steps affects the entire job across all workflow steps, not only the step where the cancellation was applied. If the job has already progressed through several workflow steps, cancelling it at a later step also changes the status of the previous steps to *cancelled*.

  It is not possible to cancel only the final workflow step while keeping the status of earlier steps intact. To retire a later step for specific target languages while keeping earlier-step statuses accurate, set that step's job status to *completed* instead of *cancelled*. Because this is a forward status change, preceding steps retain their status.

###### Change Job Status

Linguists can change the status of a job in the linguist portal or in the [editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-7174fb87-7107-2f32-ce55-5e040de5446c) under the Document menu or using the **Accept** or **Complete** buttons. Once a Linguist changes the job to Completed, the job becomes read-only and can no longer be edited.

Project managers can change the status of a job in the [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-a6d2ff65-0f54-10ab-be2f-2821d32d3c9e "Jobs Table (TMS)") or in the editor under the Document menu or using the **Accept** or **Complete** buttons.
