#### Job Tools (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557848220-Job-Tools-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-09-24T06:05:14Z  
> Labels: Linguist, Project Manager, 2BTr

The tools menu provides:

- **Emailing of the job**

  Provider must be assigned before [email templates](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709617392540#UUID-9344883c-3d65-7641-8b0e-6dfb0aeb17b1) can be applied.

  To send a new job email, follow these steps:

  1. Open the project and select the jobs to include.
  2. Click Tools and select Email.

     The email dialog opens.
  3. Select a notification template from the dropdown. Optionally, edit the subject and the body of the email.
  4. Click Send email.
- **Split file utility**

  For when multiple Linguists need to work on one file. Split files before assigning to vendors.

  - Split files cannot be unsplit, but all the files can be seen together in the editor.
  - Files split in a single workflow step can be split further in the given workflow step or in other steps.
  - Files split for all workflow steps can still be further split either for the entire workflow or just for any one of the workflow steps of the project.
  - If a workflow step is added after a file has been split in a preceding step, the split is not applied to the file in the new workflow step.
  - Splitting a file into smaller parts does not affect the target file. Completed files download as one file, not multiple smaller ones.
  - Splitting a job that has already been assigned to a provider and email does not trigger a new notification. The provider is assigned to all split job parts. Modify assignment if needed and email the job again to notify assigned providers.
  - Jobs cannot be split in [continuous projects](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703661468#UUID-575d57e6-43ea-ff19-eec2-2ac475f96341 "Continuous Projects (TMS)"). In such projects, the Split Job button is disabled.
  - The Split file utility follow [CAT editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-7174fb87-7107-2f32-ce55-5e040de5446c) segment numbers, including for files with [ICU messages](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/7765077293852#UUID-ba78486d-af7b-f9bd-e38a-d039dea68b16) and cases where segments have previously been [joined](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709695273372#UUID-5dca8a67-ad76-da5a-d4bb-c75751eeac9e) or split. If a specified segment number falls within an ICU group or a paragraph where splitting is not allowed, the system will offer the nearest valid position.

    - When using the After specific segments option, enter numbers in ascending order (e.g. `[5,13]`, not `[13,5]`). Entering the last segment number is valid, but it creates a new job rather than splitting the file.
- **Export workflow changes**

  In jobs with workflow steps, a report is generated showing changes between steps.
- **Clone**

  Only available in projects with multiple target languages.

  A copy can be made of jobs imported from an online repository, but the duplicated job cannot be uploaded back to the repository. The link to the original remote source is not retained.

  Cloning of jobs created as [multilingual MS Excel](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709604373532-Spreadsheets-MS-Excel-based-#multilingual-spreadsheet-files-0-2) or [multilingual CSV](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709618160028--CSV-Comma-Separated-Values-TMS-#multilingual-csv-file-0-2) file types is not allowed.
- **Extract terms utility**

  ### Note

  Terms can only be extracted from source texts with Latin character sets. This utility does not work with source texts in non-space languages (e.g. Chinese, Japanese, Thai).

  Terms from the source are extracted into an .xlsx file that can be edited and imported into a [term base](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503). Terms for export are defined by their maximum length in words, minimum frequency and minimum length of individual words.
- **Update source**

  A previously imported file can be updated with a new source file. The older version of the file is overwritten and cannot be restored. If the Automatically generate post-editing analysis after the source update option is specified in [settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)"), a new analysis will be generated. [Net rate scheme](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709665578908#UUID-271da169-10bc-f829-9b5d-421d21407b8f) of the provider will be applied in the new analysis.

  Jobs are updated individually, but updating the source on a file imported as Multilingual will apply the update to all imported languages.

  Translated and confirmed segments remain unchanged after a source update unless the source text has been modified. If the job is open in the [CAT web editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683890204#UUID-b7f5d899-ec2b-4352-a151-d45f6cfb5cd8) when the source is updated, a notification appears. Users can choose to reload the job later by selecting Update job in the editor header.

  It is not possible to update:

  - Jobs coming from [connectors](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709656492572#UUID-98e00ebc-37ac-490b-1577-e8f108fa5a9b). Use **Download/Reimport source from online repository** instead.
  - A split job.
  - Files outside the first workflow step.
  - ZIP files.

  Multiple jobs created from the same source can be updated at a time and the jobs must have **New**, **Emailed** or **Accepted** status. The same job can be updated every 30 minutes.

  The file name or file format of the updated job doesn't need to match the name or file format of the original job. The file name and file format will be updated accordingly.

  Analyses and quotes created before the update are marked as outdated ![yellow_warning.jpg](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682144811548). Outdated analyses can be [recalculated](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)").

  [Continuous jobs](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709711922972#UUID-16b738e3-887c-6bc1-636e-e1e51761c5b0 "Continuous Jobs - CJ (TMS)") automate the process of updating sources.
- **Update target**

  If a file is changed externally, it can be uploaded again to maintain the changes and update the relevant TM. Tags in the file may be modified and locked segments are overwritten when updated. Updates can optionally be pushed to related TMs and also optionally be automatically confirmed. The job to be updated must have **New**, **Emailed** or **Accepted** status.

  Updated targets:

  - Have no impact on [analysis](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-05eefa40-a781-cd06-519e-724f4379f416 "Analysis (TMS)") or [quotes](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709635877020#UUID-317de099-f8f9-9c94-dde1-36018cb96947).
  - Are not propagated to analytics.
  - Can be run in any [workflow](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-52eea4c5-7d94-1750-40ca-86e757b17916 "Workflow (TMS)") step.
  - Do not affect the current job status.

  Restrictions:

  - Multilingual files other than .XLIFF, .XLSX and .CSV are not supported.
  - Jobs with file extensions .PO, .TBX, .TMX, .TTX, .TS, .ZIP are not supported.
  - Maximum of 2000 paragraphs per segment.
  - Job cannot be split or continuous.
  - Job cannot originate from an online repository using a [connector](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709656492572#UUID-98e00ebc-37ac-490b-1577-e8f108fa5a9b).
  - Jobs must be imported without errors and have the same file extension as the original file.
  - Files in which the context key is not unique within the document may not update as expected.
  - Segments changed in preceding workflow steps may not be propagated further.
  - Changes are not made to the job or TM if translation is missing.

  Segments are automatically confirmed and updated in the TM if:

  - Identified as a match (scoring more than 100%).
  - It is the only segment in a paragraph with a change, scores more than 100 and does not contain any [join](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709695273372#UUID-5dca8a67-ad76-da5a-d4bb-c75751eeac9e) tags.
- **Uploading of [bilingual](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688974620#UUID-adb08905-9ca5-55e5-3739-95bd935275ea) files**
- **[Assigning providers](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687) from an existing project template**

## Translation Resources

Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/5709688837020-Translation-Resources

### Bilingual .DOCX (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688974620-Bilingual-DOCX-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-25T13:13:58Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

Jobs and [.MXLIFF](https://help.memsource.com/hc/en-us/articles/360014167260) files can be exported into a bilingual .DOCX file and imported back. This format is typically used to make minor corrections before re-importing the file back. It is not recommended for translation. Changes in locked segments of a bilingual .DOCX are ignored when the file is uploaded back.

Bilingual .DOCX files can only be reimported back to the same project and job they were originally downloaded from as each segment in the file is assigned an ID specific to that job.

Bilingual .DOCX files can be generated and uploaded from the [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-f3d84af4-6f87-460d-3d81-594a257660ac) through the Download and Tools buttons, or from the [editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-7174fb87-7107-2f32-ce55-5e040de5446c) through the Document menu.

Linguists can be restricted from using this feature in the [access and security settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82). If these options are not available, contact your administrator.

**Use cases:**

- Running a [spellcheck](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709684271516#UUID-85c5af34-be91-6f6c-e403-6e5c5f54a89a) in a text editor rather than in CAT editor.
- Passing a bilingual .DOCX file to a customer or another user who prefers working in text editors (as an *unclean* document).
- Uploading only part of a bilingual .DOCX is not directly supported, but there is a workaround:

  In the bilingual .DOCX, delete the unwanted lines. Ensure that the table header is kept at the beginning of the file. The bilingual .DOCX can then be uploaded.

**Restrictions:**

- The text is exported in a wide and long table and is not suitable for printing.
- The [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-f3d84af4-6f87-460d-3d81-594a257660ac) only presents the first 50 jobs by default to prevent long loading times of larger projects. If more than 50 jobs need to be viewed at once, add `?max=150` to the URL and reload the page.
- Do not enable and use Track changes or modify the formatting (font, color, highlighting, spacing, etc). Use *Keep Text Only* when pasting contents (up to 1000 cells at once) from an external source.
- Only the translation for the first instance of a repetition is displayed. Notification is given at the top of the bilingual .DOCX file: *When a segment gets repeated, the font is light grey, and you do NOT have to translate it.* Second and further repetition segments populated with different translations are exported to a bilingual .DOCX and updated.
- [Tags](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709695024412#UUID-9f36c0c5-d7f2-0f81-ec55-44efc63d0050) are not protected.
- In [RTL](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709562365980#UUID-17168c00-7436-5bfa-d475-e8514e51c915) languages (Arabic, Hebrew), tags such as `{2>` will be inverted to `<2{.` In order to get correct tags in Phrase, the tags in an RTL MS Word file must be `<2{` word `}2>`.
- TM, TB, and MT are not available for bilingual .DOCX files.
- [Segments](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709678012828#UUID-753af50b-27d0-e386-418a-452ed30e0083) cannot be sorted or filtered.
- Segments cannot be confirmed (they can only be uploaded and then confirmed in CAT editors).
- [Comments](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700374044#UUID-d5b89fba-f861-b990-6511-8db310f9bb86) are read-only. Changes will not be imported back.
- When using bilingual .DOCX files to move contents across jobs, bilingual tables may have up to 1000 lines. Copying large parts of text may need to be done in parts.
- Download an .MXLIFF version of a document as a local backup before uploading large or heavily modified bilingual .DOCX files. Job updates from .DOCX or .MXLIFF files cannot be undone.

Bilingual .DOCX can also be re-formatted into a Trados unclean .DOCX using MS Word macros from third-party [PlusToyz](https://blog.zappmedia.net/2012/07/a-plus-for-translator-productivity.html).

### Wildcard Search (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733449372-Wildcard-Search-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2025-08-14T13:18:26Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

Different wildcards are supported for different search types:

- Asterisks *`*`*, question marks *`?`* and quotes *`" "`* are supported in simple [translation memory](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386902899740#UUID-bafe9a04-4afd-220a-d2e5-3063d57808bc) and [term base](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10112323818908#UUID-bb305d9b-6f26-da20-eaf3-ee546aba0500) search queries.
- Only asterisks *`*`*, and question marks *`?`* are supported in [project](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709748435484#UUID-fd006a60-d1b0-dc4b-8681-00d5464cd76e) searches and when [searching across translation memories](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10421164208668#UUID-f0adefca-ea27-d636-1a3b-b590f9f3cb38).

The symbol *`*`* is limited to five uses and *`?`* to ten in any search.

###### An asterisk represents zero or more characters in a search expression.

**Example:**

Searching for *contract\** will find not only *contract* but also *contracts* and *contractual*. The query *\*auto* will find *tautology*, etc.

###### A question mark may be used to represent a single character in a search expression.

**Example:**

Searching for *ho?se* will find both *house* and *horse*.

###### Quotations will search for the exact phrase.

**Example:**

Searching for *"small car"* will not find *small blue car*.

Searching without quotations for *small car* will return any segments containing the word *small* or the word *car*.

### Filtering (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709720416796-Filtering-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-25T13:13:59Z  
> Labels: Linguist, 2BTr, ar_tms

Filtering is a method to restrict the view of data to only that which is required for a task. Filtering is used in the Phrase interface as well as the very robust editor interface.

#### Filtering in Phrase TMS

[Projects](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709748435484#UUID-fd006a60-d1b0-dc4b-8681-00d5464cd76e), [jobs](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420#UUID-33f88350-daa8-2ab2-e7ce-e35300ec60f8), [users](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5793349215900#UUID-09f99b48-09c7-b144-42bb-a1bfd2e7d452), [term bases](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503) and [translation memories](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75) can be filtered.

To filter presented data, follow these steps:

1. From a table of data, click the filter button ![Edit Filters](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052281500).

   Columns available for filtering are presented with file names as text fields and column options as dropdown lists.
2. Apply filtering requirements (requirements are automatically applied in the Projects and Jobs pages).
3. Click OK.

   The defined filter is applied to the table.
4. Click the filter button ![Edit Filters](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052281500) again to clear the filter (or click the `x` on the corner of a filter in the Project and Jobs pages).

   Click OK.

Filter settings for projects can be saved to a custom filter once the filtering criteria are applied to the table by .

1. Apply a filter using the first three steps above.
2. Click Untitled view to open the view menu.
3. Select **SAVE AS A NEW VIEW**
4. Enter a name for the view and click **Enter**.
5. Project view has been saved under the selected name and will appear in the Project filter dropdown.

To delete a custom filter, follow these steps:

1. Select the filter you want to delete in Project filter dropdown.
2. Click the dot menu to the right of the filter name to open VIEW OPTIONS.
3. Choose **DELETE**.
4. Confirm by clicking on **Delete view**.

#### Filtering in the CAT Editor

Filtering in the editor is powerful and helps linguists with workflows, translation quality and bulk operations. Unlike filtering in Phrase, filtering in the editor is applied immediately so results are displayed as filters are defined and changed.

Click ![Edit Filter Settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682067614620) to set case sensitivity and text source. Although [Context Key, Context Note](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700187292#UUID-c5aeb191-0174-35cf-92cc-93578f45ac8f) and [Tags](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709695024412#UUID-9f36c0c5-d7f2-0f81-ec55-44efc63d0050) can be filtered, Source/Target is more common and will be used in all examples.

##### Simple text filtering

Entering text into the Filter source or Filter target fields instantly displays results.

If required, the format of quotation marks and apostrophes can be customized to control the characters entered when using the respective keyboard keys.

To set or change the format of quotation marks, follow these steps:

1. Click the CAT editor menu ![Open Menu](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682099827484) and navigate to Format/Quotations.
2. Choose Source or Target to configure the quotation format for the source text or target text, respectively.
3. Select the option matching the preferred quotation style (e.g. curly or straight quotes and apostrophes, French quotation marks, etc.).

   ![quotation_menu.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052398108)

##### Replacing target text

To replace text in target, follow these steps:

1. Click ![editor_replace.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682083499804) or **CTRL+H**.

   The Replace Text field is displayed.
2. Enter text to be replaced in the Filter Target Text field.

   Segments containing provided text are displayed.
3. Provide replacement text in the Replace Text field.
4. Review the identified text with the Previous and Next buttons.
5. Click Replace to change the highlighted example or Replace All to change all identified examples.

##### Complex filtering

Multiple complex filters can be applied providing very specific content views.

Click ![Menu_Triangle.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052555292) to display complex filters.

Click ![Expand editor filters](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682131297052) to display the options for specific filters.

Select the Advanced filter option to enable the `AND` and `OR` operators for both regular and regex queries. A maximum of 5 operators is allowed per query and only one type of operator (`AND` or `OR`) can be used per query.

#### Complex Filtering Use Cases

##### Locking Repetitions

Locking secondary repetitions can provide a better [analysis](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-7ed2ed16-6064-f667-bb86-7d971d7004c9).

To lock only secondary repetitions, follow these steps:

1. Click ![Menu_Triangle.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052555292) to display complex filters.
2. Click ![Expand editor filters](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682131297052) to display Sort filters.
3. Select Most repetitions.

   Segments are filtered for most repetitions.
4. Lock **CTRL+L** repeated segments.
5. Click ![Menu_Triangle.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052555292) to display Segment status filters.
6. Select 1st repetition.

   Segments are filtered down to only 1st repetitions.
7. Unlock **CTRL+L** 1st repetitions.

Only secondary repetitions are now locked and will not be included in a refreshed analysis.

##### Filtering out segments by TM percentage

This may be used to dis-include high level TM matches from a QA.

1. From the Settings ![Setup_gear.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682083641756) page, scroll down to the Quality section and click on Quality assurance.

   The QA Checks page opens.
2. Select the Exclude locked segments from QA option.
3. Click Save.
4. From the Project Settings section, click Pre-translation.

   The Pre-translation page opens.
5. Select the Pre-translate from translation memory option and set threshold to 99%.
6. Click Save.
7. Open the job in the editor.
8. Click ![Menu_Triangle.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052555292) to display complex filters.
9. From the Pretranslated from filter, select 99%.

   Segments with TM values of 99% or higher are presented.
10. Lock **CTRL+L** the presented segments.
11. Run a [QA check](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709694857372#UUID-bccfa2a1-8f4d-d877-fc52-4d14891aba36).

High level TM matches are locked and are not included in the QA check.

##### Filtering and Sorting by Segment Metadata

This is available only for [jobs synced](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647502620#UUID-776d5a52-a0f8-d5c1-10b7-60bb343ef950) from Phrase Strings that include [custom metadata](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/11405341129628#UUID-21afd27c-d84f-5b2a-405b-ab7523497e2f).

Filtering by segment metadata allows displaying only the segments containing specific custom metadata imported from Strings.

To filter by segment metadata, follow these steps:

1. Click ![Menu_Triangle.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052555292) to display complex filters.
2. Click ![Expand editor filters](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682131297052) to display Segment metadata filters.
3. Depending on the metadata type, either select or enter a value for the desired metadata field(s).
4. Use the Contains/Doesn't contain toggle to display segments with or without the selected value(s).

Segment metadata filtering by text input can also be quickly enabled in the Filter settings ![Edit Filter Settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682067614620).

Use the Segment metadata sorting options (ascending/descending) in the complex filters ![Menu_Triangle.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682052555292) panel to sort segments based on custom metadata values. Segments without metadata are displayed at the end of the list.

### .MXLIFF Files (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709739992860--MXLIFF-Files-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-06-25T13:14:00Z  
> Labels: 2BTr, ar_tms

.MXLIFF files are Phrase specific files based on [XLIFF 1.2](http://docs.oasis-open.org/xliff/v1.2/os/xliff-core.html). The core of the file is XML and is designed for localization tools. They hold both source and target information when exported from a [job](https://help.memsource.com/hc/en-us/articles/360013675740-Jobs-Overview).

Timestamping of .MXLIFF files follow the Unix format. They can be converted using this online utility: [unixtimestamp.com](http://unixtimestamp.com).

.MXLIFFs are primarily intended for translation inside the [CAT editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683847964#UUID-7174fb87-7107-2f32-ce55-5e040de5446c) or to be directly imported via the UI and can be downloaded from the editor from the Document menu.

##### Note

If unable to download an .MXLIFF file from the CAT Desktop Editor or the CAT Web Editor, the ability to do so may have been [restricted](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82) by a project manager. Reach out to the point of contact in the organization for more information and ask to have this option enabled.

Once finished processing in the [desktop editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683873052#UUID-92b9886a-e3a5-6975-8c35-246200ac54ef) or other tools, .MXLIFF files can be imported via Tools > [Upload...](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557848220#UUID-1601e4ba-40df-d962-11d4-e2ef301430f1) from the [jobs table](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825571430172#UUID-f3d84af4-6f87-460d-3d81-594a257660ac). Multiple or large .MXLIFF files may be imported in a single .ZIP file for convenience and a quicker upload.

#### Translating MXLIFF files in other tools

##### Note

When translating .MXLIFF files outside of Phrase, it cannot be guaranteed how the files will be processed by other software.

###### SDL Trados

.MXLIFF files are only supported in SDL Trados from version Trados Studio 2021. .MXLIFF files are not automatically recognized by older versions of SDL Trados and are only imported as reference documents. To import an .MXLIFF file into SDL Trados as a translatable file, the extension must be changed to .XLIFF.

SDL Trados adds additional information to .XLIFFs that are not a native part of the .MXLIFF file format. Select the *Preserve; don't add if not originally present* [BOM option](https://drops.phrase.com/ApuGqy27) and the *Do not store segmentation information in the translated file* setting when exporting from SDL Trados to produce a file that be used with Phrase.

###### MemoQ

.MXLIFF files are supported in [memoQ 10.0](https://docs.memoq.com/current/en/Places/mxliff-files.html). If working with older versions, see [Marek Pawelec's blog post](http://wasaty.pl/blog/2018/01/30/memsource-files-in-memoq/) for current instructions.

## Users and Roles

Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/5709742377116-Users-and-Roles

### Administrator (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709753812124-Administrator-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2025-03-10T06:34:42Z  
> Labels: User Management, 2BTr, ar_tms

The Administrator is not limited by any user rights restrictions and can perform all functions.

Every organization account must have at least one Administrator user.

In terms of licensing, Project managers and Administrators are interchangeable; if there are three PM licenses, at least one must be an Administrator.

#### Administrator Tasks

As a role, the administrator is typically responsible for:

- Creating/editing/deleting [projects](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709748435484#UUID-fd006a60-d1b0-dc4b-8681-00d5464cd76e), [jobs](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420#UUID-33f88350-daa8-2ab2-e7ce-e35300ec60f8), [translation memories](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75), [term bases](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503), and [portals](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/12949538303516#UUID-0af9ae02-cbd1-1c17-aec5-541956f27282).
- Creating/editing/deleting other users.

  The number and type of [user roles](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5793349215900#UUID-09f99b48-09c7-b144-42bb-a1bfd2e7d452) that can be managed is subject to subscription-based limitations. Hover over the New button in the Users page to see which users are available as per [subscription](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709562237852#UUID-434a564b-d712-4b4b-597b-79c63299f56c).
- Managing [email notifications](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82).
- Organization settings under Settings:

  - Organization settings are applied to templates when creating projects.
  - White-labeling the system (e.g apply a custom logo).

### Project Manager (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756503196-Project-Manager-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-08-17T06:01:15Z  
> Labels: User Management, 2BTr, ar_tms

Project managers are in charge of project management, the creation or modification of projects, assignment creation, [TM](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75)s, [TB](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503)s and [resources](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/5709688837020) management.

Although Project managers have almost the same rights as the Administrator, they cannot view or modify the subscription. If a PM is also acting as a linguist, [relevancy](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709735838492#UUID-5cf23a7c-9059-4469-d5af-19184af2f8a6_UUID-5fa1f13f-c0a0-55ad-c6d7-b97cb2cc43d7 "Set Linguist Relevancy") settings can also be applied.

###### Owners

A PM can be assigned as the Owner of a project, project template, TM, or TB created by another user and gains the same user rights as if it had been created by them.

PM permissions can be set so that they don't have the right to view/edit/delete projects created by other users unless the PM is set as the owner of the project.

###### Job owner

Apart from being the owner of an entire project, project template, TM, or TB, Project managers and Administrators can also become job owners. Each user who imports a job into a project automatically becomes the job owner and receives notifications of status changes of such jobs.

If not familiar with project manager tasks, see the [Quick Start Guide](https://phrase.com/resources/phrase-tms-quick-start-guide-linguists/).

#### Set Project Manager User Rights

Project managers user rights are set by an Administrator and can be very restrictive if required.

When a project manager is assigned as the provider, their PM permissions take precedence. As an example, when a PM has access limited to a specific business unit and is assigned to a job in another unit, they will not be able to access it.

To set PM user rights, follow these steps:

1. From the Users page, select a user and click Edit.

   The Edit page opens.
2. Ensure the Role is Project manager.

   Settings specific to the Project manager role are displayed.
3. Select required restrictions and click Save.

   Settings are applied to the specified user.

##### Project Manager Access and Permissions

Administrators, and project managers who have the relevant permissions, can configure the following settings for other Project Manager (PM) users:

##### Projects

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Create projects | Allows the PM to create new projects (default: enabled). |
| View projects created by other users | Allows the PM to view projects created by other users. The PM sees these projects in the project list and can open each project's page directly. |
| Modify projects created by other users | Allows the PM to modify projects created by other users. |
| Delete projects created by other users | Allows the PM to delete projects created by other users. |
| Access projects of selected clients only | Restricts the PM's access to projects assigned to selected clients only. |
| Access projects of selected business units only | Restricts the PM's access to projects assigned to selected business units only. |
| Access projects of selected buyers only | Restricts the PM's access to selected buyers only. Empty selection means unrestricted. |

##### Project Templates

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Create project templates | Allows the PM to create new project templates. |
| View project templates created by other users | Allows the PM to view templates created by other users. The PM cannot open a template created by another user to see its details. |
| Modify project templates created by other users | Allows the PM to modify templates created by other users. |
| Delete project templates created by other users | Allows the PM to delete templates created by other users. |
| Access project templates of selected clients only | Restricts the PM's access to templates assigned to selected clients only. |
| Access project templates of selected business units only | Restricts the PM's access to templates assigned to selected business units only. |

##### Translation Memories (TMs)

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Create TMs | Allows the PM to create new TMs. |
| View TMs created by other users | Allows the PM to view TMs created by other users. The PM sees these TM's in the TM list and can open each TM's page directly. |
| Modify TMs created by other users | Allows the PM to modify TMs created by other users. |
| Delete TMs created by other users | Allows the PM to delete TMs created by other users. |
| Export TMs created by other users | Allows the PM to export TMs created by other users. |
| Import into TMs created by other users | Allows the PM to import into TMs created by other users. |
| Access TMs of selected clients only | Restricts the PM's access to TMs assigned to selected clients only. |
| Access TMs of selected business units only | Restricts the PM's access to TMs assigned to selected business units only. |

##### Term Bases (TBs)

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Create TBs | Allows the PM to create new TBs. |
| View TBs created by other users | Allows the PM to view TBs created by other users. The PM sees these TB's in the TB list and can open each TB's page directly. |
| Modify TBs created by other users | Allows the PM to modify TBs created by other users. |
| Delete TBs created by other users | Allows the PM to delete TBs created by other users. |
| Export TBs created by other users | Allows the PM to export TBs created by other users. |
| Import into TBs created by other users | Allows the PM to import into TBs created by other users. |
| Approve terms in TBs created by other users | Allows the PM to approve terms in TBs created by other users. |
| Access TBs of selected clients only | Restricts the PM's access to TBs assigned to selected clients only. |
| Access TBs of selected business units only | Restricts the PM's access to TBs assigned to selected business units only. |

##### Users

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Create users | Allows the PM to create new users. |
| View users created by other users | Allows the PM to view users created by other users. The PM sees these in the users list and can open each user's page directly. |
| Modify users created by other users | Allows the PM to modify users created by other users. |
| Delete users created by other users | Allows the PM to delete users created by other users. |

##### Clients, Domains, Subdomains

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Create clients, domains, subdomains | Allows the PM to create new clients, domains, and subdomains. |
| View clients, domains, subdomains created by other users | Allows the PM to view clients/domains/subdomains created by other users. The PM sees these in the clients/domains/subdomains lists and can open each client/domain/subdomain's page directly. |
| Modify clients, domains, subdomains created by other users | Allows the PM to modify clients/domains/subdomains created by other users. |
| Delete clients, domains, subdomains created by other users | Allows the PM to delete clients/domains/subdomains created by other users. |
| Analytics dashboards | Controls access level for the Analytics dashboards. Three levels are available:  - View all organization data. - View only data from projects the project manager owns. - No dashboard access. |

##### Vendors

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Create vendors | Allows the PM to create new vendors. |
| View vendors created by other users | Allows the PM to view vendors created by other users. The PM cannot open a vendor created by another user to see its details. |
| Modify vendors created by other users | Allows the PM to modify vendors created by other users. |
| Delete vendors created by other users | Allows the PM to delete vendors created by other users. |

##### Other

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Modify global server settings | Allows the PM access to all other settings except for those that offer separate access rights (i.e. project / project templates / TMs / TBs / users / clients, domains, subdomains / vendors / analytics dashboards). It also grants the PM access to [Phrase Language AI](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709660879516#UUID-b0d64b4f-fa01-f7c3-006a-40e0ee0dedd2) and the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76). |

When both a client and a business unit are specified, only projects, templates, TMs, or TBs matching both are shown.

### Linguist (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709735838492-Linguist-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2026-08-04T06:00:31Z  
> Labels: User Management, 2BTr, ar_tms

The Linguist role is that of a translator, reviewer or proofreader. [Jobs](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420#UUID-33f88350-daa8-2ab2-e7ce-e35300ec60f8) are assigned to Linguists by [project managers](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756503196#UUID-7f48b934-9536-62ce-8c9e-3aaca9f95cfe "Project Manager (TMS)") and when notification is received, the Linguist logs into the [linguist portal](https://support.phrase.com#UUID-5cf23a7c-9059-4469-d5af-19184af2f8a6_UUID-cbf40c4c-9130-9844-ff10-25bc2b982151 "Linguist Portal") to accept and complete assignments. Linguists can also be assigned to specific [workflow steps](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-3d4fec12-4a9f-ace5-cd20-a1575786a6b7).

The role was designed for freelance translators from outside a translation company and they do not have any project management rights. When a new Linguist is created by a Project manager, the Linguist receives an automatic email with their username and the instructions on how to [set up a password](https://support.phrase.com/document/preview/7928#UUID-bddb003f-dc32-06ed-f92f-75c473c51ee7).

- Linguists do not own their profiles.
- Linguists only get access to projects assigned to them by project managers. Only [TM](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75)s and [TB](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503)s assigned to these projects will be available.
- Linguists cannot make any changes to a project's settings.
- Linguists cannot attach their own private [translation memories](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75), [term bases](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503) or machine translation engines.
- Linguists can edit jobs, including running pre-translation, only when the job status is *Accepted*.
- Linguists can perform LQA assessments only when the job status is *Accepted*.
- Linguists will not see assigned jobs if they are logged into the wrong organization or using the wrong username. To fix this, the linguist should [switch to the correct organization](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/6091807042076#UUID-3b204035-bb79-8662-cb38-a08bb599962b) and make sure they are logged in with the username assigned by the project manager.

If not familiar with project manager tasks, see the [Quick Start Guide](https://phrase.com/resources/phrase-tms-quick-start-guide-linguists/).

#### Set Linguist User Rights

Linguist user rights are generally about ability to use and modify [translation resources](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/5709688837020). The net rate scheme and price list are used to help calculate [quotes](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709635877020#UUID-317de099-f8f9-9c94-dde1-36018cb96947). Rights are set by an Administrator or Project manager.

To set Linguist user rights, follow these steps:

1. From the Users page, select a user and click Edit.

   The Edit page opens.
2. Ensure the Role is Linguist.

   Settings specific to the Linguist role and edition are displayed.

   - Edit translations in TM

     If enabled, the linguist can access the TM and edit translations in the [translation memory page](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/9386902899740#UUID-bafe9a04-4afd-220a-d2e5-3063d57808bc) directly.

     If disabled, the linguist has read-only access to the TM. Their work will be saved to the TM when the segments are confirmed if the TM is set as *Write* in the project.
   - Enable MT

     If disabled, the linguist:

     - Cannot pre-translate with MT via the jobs table or the editor. Pre-translation from translation memory or non-translatables remains available.
     - Will not be able to see MT suggestions in the CAT pane.
     - Will not see the origin or score of an MT suggestion if the segment has been pre-translated by a PM.
   - Edit all terms in TB

     If enabled, the linguist can edit and delete all terms in the term base attached to a project they are assigned to.

     If disabled, the linguist can only edit or delete the terms they have added in a [TB set as Write](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/12619560579868#UUID-1ad0d99c-bd10-8689-3533-bf1acd23388b) in the project.
3. Select required restrictions and click Save.

   Settings are applied to the specified user.

#### Set Linguist Relevancy

When a Linguist completes at least one job in a project with certain languages and specific project metadata, such information is saved to the Linguist's profile as *relevancy*.

By leveraging relevancy information, jobs inside a project can be assigned to the most relevant providers. The better the match with the language pair and project metadata, the higher relevancy score is automatically calculated for each provider. Most relevant providers will be suggested first upon [job creation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709686763420#UUID-33f88350-daa8-2ab2-e7ce-e35300ec60f8), as they most likely have translated similar content in previous assignments.

To set Linguist relevancy, follow these steps:

1. From the Users page, select a user and click Edit.

   The Edit page opens.
2. Ensure the Role is Linguist.

   Settings specific to the Linguist role and edition are displayed.
3. Click Relevancy at the bottom of the page to expand the relevant section.
4. Select available project metadata as required to set up relevancy information.
5. Click Save.

   Settings are applied to the specified user.

Source and target language pairs are visible and editable only while a user's role is set to Linguist. The language section does not appear on the Edit page for Administrator, Project Manager, or other roles. Changing a user's role away from Linguist does not automatically clear existing language pairs. The pairs remain stored on the account, hidden until the role changes back to Linguist. This has no functional effect for non-Linguist roles, since Phrase does not use language pairs to assign work outside the Linguist role. To clear stored language pairs, switch the role to Linguist, remove the pairs on the Edit page, then set the role back to its original value.

#### Assign, Change or Remove Linguists in a Job

Project managers can assign Linguists to one or multiple jobs by [editing the desired job(s)](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825557726492#UUID-e69fba74-93f9-2b07-a90c-69d3c98a8ed6) in the relevant project page.

#### Linguist Portal

##### Available for

- All paid plans

A page specifically for Linguists to manage assigned jobs.

Linguist portal functions:

- Accepting translation jobs.
- Translating jobs in the [CAT web editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683890204#UUID-b7f5d899-ec2b-4352-a151-d45f6cfb5cd8).
- Downloading bilingual MXLIFF files to start translating in the [CAT desktop editor](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709683873052#UUID-92b9886a-e3a5-6975-8c35-246200ac54ef).
- Viewing a wordcount analysis, including any [net rates](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709665578908#UUID-271da169-10bc-f829-9b5d-421d21407b8f), if applied.
- Virtually [joining](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709695273372#UUID-5dca8a67-ad76-da5a-d4bb-c75751eeac9e) multiple files into a single one.
- Marking translation jobs as *Completed by Linguist*.
- Searching and editing term bases related to their jobs.

Project managers can control whether Linguist profiles are activated and deactivated automatically based on job assignment, via Activate/Deactivate Linguists automatically under [Access and security](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82) settings. Inactive Linguists remain visible and selectable in the provider assignment dropdown regardless of this setting.

- When this option is enabled:

  - A Linguist's profile is automatically deactivated once they have no jobs in progress.
  - Assigning a new job to the profile automatically reactivates it, allowing the Linguist to access TMS and accept the job.
  - Once the assigned job is completed or removed, the Linguist is automatically deactivated again.
- When this option is disabled:

  - Linguist profiles are not managed automatically: activation and deactivation must be done manually by a PM or Administrator.
  - Assigning a job to an inactive Linguist does not activate them.
  - The Linguist will appear greyed out in the project's jobs list and cannot access TMS to accept the job until their account is manually activated.

Project managers may set strict [quality assurance](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709703799324#UUID-83632035-0d65-f957-b0dd-ad00704f8d25) rules forcing the Linguist to run a [QA check](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709694857372#UUID-bccfa2a1-8f4d-d877-fc52-4d14891aba36) and mitigate all findings before the job can be set to Complete.

Project managers may restrict work on higher [workflow](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709717879324#UUID-3d4fec12-4a9f-ace5-cd20-a1575786a6b7) steps from commencing before a previous step is complete. This will not allow the Linguist to open the job. If a job is split, an email notification regarding review of a job may be received, yet all jobs resulting from the split must be complete before moving on to next step.

##### Jobs view

Translation jobs assigned to the linguist are presented in a table with acceptance buttons and filtering options. Information about the jobs is presented in columns that can be used to sort the jobs. Columns can be customized and saved. If a linguist is removed from a job, it will not appear in the list.

In the jobs view the Linguist can:

- Change the job's status.
- Click on the job name to open the job in CAT web editor.
- Click on the project's name to open the project and access all the project's tools, such as download files, pre-translate, view Analysis, TM/TB, etc..
- Filter the jobs list.

##### Projects view

Projects associated with the linguist are presented in a sortable list. Filters can be applied using the Filter button and saved as custom views by clicking the arrow next to the view name and selecting Save as a new view. Changes to an existing view can be saved by clicking Save changes in view. Saved views can be duplicated, renamed and deleted from the ![Open Vertical Menu](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682080440092) menu next to the view name.

Click on a project to view project details:

- Translation Jobs.
- Wordcount [analysis](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709712007708#UUID-7ed2ed16-6064-f667-bb86-7d971d7004c9) (if assigned to the Linguist by the PM).
- [Quotes](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709635877020#UUID-317de099-f8f9-9c94-dde1-36018cb96947) (if assigned to the Linguist by the PM).
- [Translation memory](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709688865692#UUID-c58dd835-39ea-1a94-02d1-9f2517fd6d75) (if assigned to the project).
- [Term base](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709733372188#UUID-ca45e09b-442e-336f-3257-2983bccd0503) (if assigned to the project).
- [Reference](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709748435484#UUID-fd006a60-d1b0-dc4b-8681-00d5464cd76e) files (if assigned to the project).

When Linguists change a job's status, their project manager is sent an email notification based on [email templates](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709617392540#UUID-9344883c-3d65-7641-8b0e-6dfb0aeb17b1), if enabled in [project settings](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709585565980#UUID-424b8fbe-2d60-48eb-891a-a4f1c5004c82).

##### Translation memories view

Translation memories that have been directly shared with the linguist are displayed as well as shared translation memories from currently assigned jobs. Shared translation memories are set to being editable or read-only by the project manager.

###### Term bases view

Displays term bases from projects in which the linguist has an assigned job.

Linguists can edit and delete all terms in such a term base only if Edit all terms in TB is enabled in their profile. If disabled, they can edit or delete only the terms they have added themselves.

##### Filter options

- **All**

  - All jobs, current and past.
  - All projects are displayed.
- **Accepted work**

  - Translation jobs that have been accepted by the Linguist and have not yet been completed.
  - Projects where at least one job is *Accepted* but no jobs have *New* or *Emailed* status.
- **Completed work**

  - Translation jobs that have been marked as *Completed by Linguist*. Once set to *Completed*, the job is no longer editable for the Linguist, but can still be opened as read-only. Linguists still can add or reply to a comment in the [conversation](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709700374044#UUID-d5b89fba-f861-b990-6511-8db310f9bb86) in jobs marked as *Completed*.
  - Projects where all jobs are *Completed* by the linguist or *Delivered*.
- **New work**

  - Jobs that have not been accepted by the Linguist are displayed. The status field can be used to accept or decline translation jobs.
  - Projects where at least one job has *New* or *Emailed* status.

Filters applied to columns in the jobs view can be saveds as customs views by clicking the ![settings-7648874d097d6f25724f48b0f3da9403.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682049955228) icon, selecting Save filter as… Provide the name of the view and click Save.

To remove a duplicate or unwanted custom view, select the view to delete from the views dropdown, click the ![settings-7648874d097d6f25724f48b0f3da9403.png](https://support.phrase.com/hc/article_attachments/30682049955228) icon and then Delete filter. This option is only available for views created by the user and does not apply to the built-in filters (All, Accepted work, Completed work, New work).

### Guest (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756557724-Guest-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2024-12-16T06:36:27Z  
> Labels: User Management, 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Team, Ultimate and Enterprise plans (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Guests are similar to the [project manager](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756503196#UUID-7f48b934-9536-62ce-8c9e-3aaca9f95cfe "Project Manager (TMS)") role excepting they are limited to the projects, translation memories, or term bases of a specific client. Like the Project manager, the Guest user role is highly customizable. A Guest role can be used to share Phrase resources with clients themselves so that they may review TMs and TBs.

The Guest role allows users to do any of the following for a specific client:

- View projects (but not [project templates](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687))
- View/edit jobs in the editor (but cannot change job's status)
- View and modify translation memories
- View and modify term bases
- View analyses
- View references
- Download completed files

To select a specific client for Guest users, ensure that the client has been created using [project metadata](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/10825060790556#UUID-46489564-e04e-194b-c391-058c29a1301f) settings. A Guest user can have only one assigned client.

#### Set Guest User Rights

Much like Project managers, Guest rights can be very restrictive if required and are set by an Administrator or Project manager.

To set Guest user rights, follow these steps:

1. From the Users page, select a user and click Edit.

   The Edit page opens.
2. Ensure the Role is Guest.

   Settings specific to the Guest role are displayed.
3. Select required restrictions and click Save.

   Settings are applied to the specified user.

### Submitter (TMS)

> Quelle: https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709767598876-Submitter-TMS  
> Zuletzt aktualisiert: 2025-08-14T13:19:06Z  
> Labels: User Management, 2BTr, ar_tms

#### Available for

- Ultimate and Enterprise plans (Legacy)

Get in touch with [Sales](https://phrase.com/demo/) for licensing questions.

Submitter profiles are an extension of the [submitter portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709602111132#UUID-560b5531-f46e-bcd6-82d9-9a69f2af4a76).

The Submitter role allows organizations to create submitter portals requiring login via username and password. Multiple submitter portals can be attached to portals giving access to several submission interfaces. These interfaces can include different types of documents, subject areas, as a predefined set of analytics, etc..

If shared by a [Phrase Portal](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/12949538303516#UUID-0af9ae02-cbd1-1c17-aec5-541956f27282) administrator, the Submitter role can also access existing [Phrase Language AI](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709660879516#UUID-b0d64b4f-fa01-f7c3-006a-40e0ee0dedd2) portals.

Ten Submitter users can be assigned with every licensed [project manager](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709756503196#UUID-7f48b934-9536-62ce-8c9e-3aaca9f95cfe "Project Manager (TMS)").

Portals can be used to:

- Order new jobs via the attached submitter portals.
- Use the Projects tab for an overview of ongoing or finished projects.
- Download completed files.

Assigning a client to a Submitter user is not possible:

- Edit Submitter user rights to add active portals or allow viewing of projects from other Submitters.
- Alternatively, add client metadata directly to the [project template](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709647439772#UUID-94346683-ae2a-16b5-7e16-94a554612687) configured for the [Service](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/articles/5709616197788#UUID-1614da62-87e2-eb83-1fd1-a65b8d4f37d4). The submitter portal follows settings defined in the Service.
